l-m-h3-b0c38-10.title: Maxaa aan u baahanahay si aan u helno fursad shuruudaysan?
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.goal: Ogow halbeegga (xogta) lagama maarmaanka u ah helidda fursadda shuruudaysan ee dhacdada A inay dhacdo marka la bixiyo dhacdada B, oo sharax sababta aad u doortay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.material: Waxaan dhisaynaa shaandho spam ah. Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno fursadda P(A|B) ee email inuu yahay spam (A) marka uu ka kooban yahay erayga 'free' (B). Aan garano labada fursadood ee lagama maarmaanka ah.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.prompt: Labada qiime kee ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah helidda P(A|B)?
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.r.a: Labadan oo keliya, P(A|B) lama go'aamiyo. Waxaad u baahan tahay isgooyska.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.r.b: Labadan waxaa loo isticmaalaa helidda P(B|A). Tixraacu waa dhinaca kale.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.r.d: Midaynta oo keliya ma kuu sheegayso isgooyska.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B). Waa saamiga, inta xaaladaha B dhacdo dhexdooda, ee A sidoo kale dhacdo.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s2.model.0: Wuxuu isticmaalaa xaaladaha B dhaco oo keliya sida tixraac, sidaas darteed hooseeyuhu waa P(B) korreeyaha-na wuxuu u baahan yahay P(A∩B), fursadda labaduba wada dhacaan.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s2.model.1: Leh P(A) iyo P(B) oo keliya, ma ogtid inta jeer ee labaduba wada dhacaan, sidaas darteed lama go'aamin, isgooyska-na waa loo baahan yahay.

l-m-h3-b0d07-03.material: Waxaad rabtaa inaad go'aamiso in isku xigga {rⁿ} uu isku imaanayo mise kala firdhanayo. Maxaad u baahan tahay inaad ka ogaato saamiga guud r?
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.prompt: Xogtee ayaa si buuxda u xalliya isku imaanshaha, wax lagu reebin la'aan?
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.b: Haddii r=1 wuxuu isku imaanayaa 1, halbeeggan oo keliya wuu seegi lahaa taas.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.c: r=2 waa togan laakiin wuu kala firdhadaa, r=−0.5 na waa taban laakiin wuu isku imaanayaa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.d: r=1/2 maaha tiro dhan laakiin wuxuu isku imaanayaa 0.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.explain: Haddii −1<r<1 wuxuu isku imaanayaa 0, haddii r=1 wuxuu isku imaanayaa 1, haddii r≤−1 ama r>1 na wuu kala firdhadaa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s2.model.0: Marka r=1 taxanuhu sidoo kale wuxuu isku imaanayaa 1, halka r≤−1 ama r>1 uu kala firdhado, sidaa darteed waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato haddii −1<r≤1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s2.model.1: Haddii aad eegto |r|<1 oo keliya, waad seegtaa r=1, sidaa darteed waa inaad hubisaa haddii −1<r≤1 si aad si sax ah u go'aamiso haddii taxanuhu isku imaanayo.

l-m-h3-b0d08-03.material: Tirooyin togan a iyo b, waxaad rabtaa inaad go'aamiso qiimaha lim(n→∞) (aⁿ+bⁿ)/(aⁿ⁺¹+bⁿ⁺¹).
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.prompt: Xog noocee ah ayaa hubaal loo baahan yahay si loo go'aamiyo qiimaha?
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.a: Xitaa isla a+b, xadadka (2,1) iyo (1.5,1.5) way kala duwan yihiin.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.o.b: Kee ka mid ah a iyo b ayaa weyn
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.o.c: Haddii a iyo b ay yihiin tirooyin dhamaystiran
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.c: Xitaa haddii aysan dhamaystirnayn, qiimaha xadku waa go'an yahay.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.o.d: Haddii n yahay lammaane ama paar
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.d: Haddii a iyo b ay togan yihiin, haddii n lammaane ama paar tahay muhiim ma aha.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.explain: Xadku waa 1/max(a, b). Awoodda midka weyn ayaa maamusha korreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s2.model.0: Awoodda tirada weyn ayaa maamusha isku-darka, sidaas darteed xadku wuxuu noqdaa 1/(tirada weyn), sidaas darteed waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato kee ayaa weyn.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s2.model.1: Haddii a>b, markaas (b/a)ⁿ→0, sidaas darteed xadku waa 1/a, xitaa haddii a=b waa 1/a, sidaas darteed ogaanshaha kan weyn ee labada ayaa go'aamiya xadka.

l-m-h3-b0d09-02.goal: Go'aami halbeegga (macluumaadka) runtii loo baahan yahay si loo helo waxa kala saara ellipse iyo hyperbola, oo sharax sababta aad u dooratay.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.material: Waxaa jira laba bar oo go'an F iyo F′ iyo bar dhaqaaqaysa P. Haddii aad shuruud ka dejiso masaafooyinka PF iyo PF′, ellipse ama hyperbola ayaa la sawiraa. Hel shuruudda kala saarta labada.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.a: Haddii PF ay ka dheer tahay ama ka gaaban tahay PF′
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.r.a: Kee ayaa ka dheer noocyada qalooca ma go'aamiyo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.b: Haddii masaafada u dhexaysa F iyo F′ ay tahay tiro dhan
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.r.b: Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan waxba kuma laha nooca qalooca.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.c: Haddii barta P ay ka sarreyso x-axis
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.r.c: Meel kasta oo barta ay joogto, waxba kuma laha nooca qalooca.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.o.d: Haddii ay tahay wadarka PF iyo PF′ ama qiimaha saafiga ah ee farqigooda
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s1.explain: Ellipse waa kooxda baraha PF+PF′ uu joogto yahay, hyperbola-na waa kooxda baraha |PF−PF′| uu joogto yahay. Haddii ay tahay wadar ama farqi ayaa kala saara labada.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s2.model.0: Haddii wadarku joogto yahay waa ellipse, haddii qiimaha saafiga ah ee farqigu joogto yahayna waa hyperbola, sidaas darteed habkaas xisaabinta ayaa ah halbeegga.
l-m-h3-b0d09-02.s.s2.model.1: Doorashooyinka kale ma beddeli karaan nooca qalooca. Qeexitaannadu waxay ku kala baxaan wadar ama farqi, sidaas darteed taasi waa halbeegga.

l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.prompt: Qiimee ayaa kuu sheegaya haddii xagalku yahay af-fiiqan ama af-baaxad?
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.r.a: Cabbirradu had iyo jeer waa togan yihiin, sidaas darteed ma sheegi karaan nooca xagalka.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.o.b: Wadarta qaybaha x ee labada vector
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.r.b: Wadarta qaybuhu xidhiidh toos ah kuma laha xagalka u dhexeeya vector-yada.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.r.c: Wax-ku-dhigga cabbirradu sidoo kale had iyo jeer waa togan yahay, sidaas darteed ma sheegi karo nooca xagalka.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s1.explain: Gudaha a·b=|a||b|cosθ, cabbirradu waa togan yihiin, sidaas darteed calaamadda waxaa go'aamisa cosθ. Haddii ay togan tahay xagalku waa af-fiiqan, haddii ay taban tahay-na xagalku waa af-baaxad.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s2.model.0: Cabbirka |a||b| had iyo jeer waa togan yahay, sidaas darteed calaamadda wax-ku-dhigga dot waa isla calaamadda cosθ: togan xagal af-fiiqan, taban-na xagal af-baaxad.
l-m-h3-b0d09-17.s.s2.model.1: Qiimayaasha kale waa cabbirro ama wadarrooyin qaybo ah, sidaas darteed ma hayaan macluumaad ku saabsan jihada xagalka. Taasi waa sababta calaamadda wax-ku-dhigga dot ay tahay halbeegga lagama maarmaanka ah.

l-m-h3-b0d10-03.material: Waxaad rabtaa inaad isla'eg qaabka Ax² + By² = 1 (A iyo B waa lambarro kala duwan, midna ma aha 0) ku kala soocdo ellipse, hyperbola, ama qalooc aan lahayn bero gabi ahaanba. Maxaad eegtaa?
l-m-h3-b0d10-03.s.s1.o.a: Kee ka mid ah A iyo B ayaa ka weyn
l-m-h3-b0d10-03.s.s1.r.a: Xitaa haddii A>B, waxay ku xidhan tahay haddii labadu yihiin togan ama taban.
l-m-h3-b0d10-03.s.s1.o.b: Immisa ka mid ah A iyo B ayaa togan
l-m-h3-b0d10-03.s.s1.r.c: Haddii wadarku yahay 1 ama aan ahayn, nooca waxaa go'aamiya calaamadaha.
l-m-h3-b0d10-03.s.s1.o.d: Haddii A iyo B ay yihiin tiro dhan
l-m-h3-b0d10-03.s.s1.explain: Haddii labaduba yihiin togan, waa ellipse; haddii hal keliya uu yahay togan, hyperbola; haddii labaduba yihiin taban, bero ma jiraan. Calaamadaha ayaa go'aamiya nooca.
l-m-h3-b0d10-03.s.s2.model.0: Calaamadaha x² iyo y² hortooda ku yaal ayaa go'aamiya qalooca, sidaas darteed tirinta lambarrada togan waxay kala saartaa ellipse, hyperbola, iyo xal la'aan.
l-m-h3-b0d10-03.s.s2.model.1: Haddii A iyo B labaduba yihiin taban, dhinaca bidix waa 0 ama ka yar oo bar ma buuxiso =1, sidaas darteed calaamadaha ayaa ah halbeegga muhiimka ah.

l-m-h3-b0d10-32.goal: Go'aamin xogta runtii loo baahan yahay si loo helo xiriirka booska ee kubad iyo dusha, oo sharax sababta aad u doorteen.
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan ogaano xiriirka booska (kulmid, taabasho, ama aan kulmin) ee kubadda (x−1)² + (y−2)² + (z−3)² = 25 iyo dusha z = k. Maxaan isbarbar dhigaa?
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s1.prompt: Maxaan isbarbar dhigaa si aan u go'aamino xiriirka booska?
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s1.o.a: Haddii qiimaha k uu yahay lammaane
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s1.r.a: Haddii k tahay lammaane ama kali wax xiriir ah kuma laha booska kubadda iyo dusha.
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s1.o.b: Masaafada laga bilaabo udub-dhexaadka ilaa dusha, iyo gacan-qaadka
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s1.o.c: Isugeynta isku-xidhayaasha x iyo y ee udub-dhexaadka
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s1.r.c: Xiriirka dusha z=k waxaa go'aamiya isku-xidhka z.
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s1.r.d: Dusha wuu sii fidaa weligiis, sidaa darteed aagga lama isbarbar dhigi karo.
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s1.explain: Masaafada laga bilaabo udub-dhexaadka (1,2,3) ilaa dusha z=k waa |k−3|. Haddii ay ka yar tahay 5 way kulmaan, haddii ay siman yihiin way taabanayaan, haddii ay ka weyn tahay na ma kulmaan.
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s2.model.0: Booska kubad iyo dusha wuxuu ku xiran yahay haddii masaafada |k−3| laga bilaabo udub-dhexaadka ilaa dusha ay ka weyn tahay ama ka yar tahay gacan-qaadka 5, sidaa darteed waxaan isbarbar dhigaynaa labadaas.
l-m-h3-b0d10-32.s.s2.model.1: Haddii |k−3|=5 way taabanayaan, haddii ay ka yar tahay 5 na qayb goobool ah ayaa samaysanta, sidaa darteed waxaan u baahanahay inaan isbarbar dhigno masaafada iyo gacan-qaadka.

l-m-h3-b0c42-13.material: Xaalado wada weynaada oo wada yaraada: ① erayo iyo dherer (da') ② iibka qaboojiyaha hawada iyo iibka cabitaannada (heerkul) ③ dhibcaha akhriska iyo cabbirka kabaha (fasalka). U dabaq xeerkan 'iibka dallaayadaha iyo tirada daahista'.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.prompt: Marka iibka dallaayadaha iyo tirada daahista ay wada kordhaan, sharaxaadee ayaa ku habboon?
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.a: Dallaayado badan ayaa la iibiyaa, sidaa darteed ardaydu way daahaan
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.a: Wuxuu u qaatay in mid ka mid ah uu yahay sababta kan kale.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.b: Ardaydu way daahaan, sidaa darteed dallaayado badan ayaa la iibiyaa
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.b: Wuxuu u qaatay sababta iyo saameynta si rogan.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.c: Midabka dallaayadda ayaa go'aamiya haddii aad daahdo
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.r.c: Wuxuu sameeyey xiriir cusub oo aan lahayn aasaas.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.o.d: Maalmaha roobka ayaa laga yaabaa inay labada kordhiyeen
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s1.explain: Sida xaaladihii hore, laba qiime oo wada isbeddela ka dambeysa waxaa laga yaabaa inay jirto arrin 3aad oo saameyneysa labadaba. Halkan, roob ayaa ku habboon.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s2.model.0: Ee ① ilaa ③, arrin 3aad sida da', heerkul, ama fasal ayaa labada qiime wada dhaqaajisay, sidaa darteed dallaayadaha iyo daahistana, roobku wuxuu noqon karaa sababta guud.
l-m-h3-b0c42-13.s.s2.model.1: Ka hor inta aan la u qaadin in mid keeno kan kale, waa inaad raadisaa arrin saameynaysa labadaba, sidaa darteed maalmaha roobku waa kan ugu habboon.

l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s1.r.b: 3 ee lagu daray sidoo kale waxaa lagu dhuftay 0.5.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s1.r.d: 0.5 ee lagu dhufto waa la iska daayay, 3 oo keliya ayaa lagu daray.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s1.explain: Qiimaha la filayo ee Y=aX+b waa a×E(X)+b. 0.5×10+3=8.
l-m-h3-b0c42-19.s.s2.model.0: Xaaladaha, 2×3=6, 5+4=9, 3×2−1=5, sidaas darteed lambarka lagu dhufto waxaa lagu dhufanayaa qiimaha la filayo lambarka lagu daro-na waa la ku darayaa, taas oo bixisa 0.5×10+3=8.

l-m-h3-b0d08-07.title: Qiyaasidda xadka isku-xigg lagu qeexay soo noqnoqod
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.goal: Ka hel oo sheeg qaab dhowr kiis oo ku saabsan xadka a₁=√2, aₙ₊₁=√(2+aₙ), kadibna qaabka ku hubi kiis cusub.

l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad ku khaldantay L=2+L. Waxaa jira xidid laba-jibbaaran.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s1.r.b: a₂ wuxuu ka badan yahay 1.5, sidaas darteed xadku wuu ka weyn yahay taas.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s1.r.d: Kaasi waa qiimaha a₄. Isku-xiggu wuu sii kordhayaa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-07.s.s1.explain: Haddii xadku yahay L, markaas L=√(2+L). Laga bilaabo L²−L−2=0, L=2.

l-m-h3-b0d08-20.title: Qaab ku saabsan meesha fₙ(x)=xe^(−nx) ugu weyn yahay
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.goal: Hel oo sheeg qaab dhowr xaaladood oo x halkaas oo fₙ(x)=x·e^(−nx) ugu weyn yahay, ka dibna ku hubi qaabka xaalad cusub.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.material: Marka n=1, 2, 3, fₙ(x)=x·e^(−nx) wuxuu leeyahay qiimaha ugu badan marka x=1, 1/2, 1/3 siday u kala horreeyaan. Isticmaal qaabka si aad u qiyaasto x halkaas oo ugu badnaantu dhacdo marka n=5.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.prompt: Marka n=5, x kee ayaa ugu weyn?
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.r.a: Marka n=1 waa 1, sidaas darteed hooseeyuhu waa n, ma aha n−1 (leh n−1, n=1 ma shaqaynaysay).
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.r.d: Jihada x ay yaraato marka n weynaado waa la rogay.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s1.explain: Laga bilaabo fₙ'(x)=(1−nx)e^(−nx)=0, x=1/n, wuxuuna ka beddelaa + ilaa − dhinac kasta, sidaas darteed waa ugu badnaan.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s2.model.0: 1, 1/2, 1/3 dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin qaabka 1/n, sidaas darteed marka n=5, x=1/5, kala duwiddu-na waxay bixisaa (1−5x)e^(−5x)=0, taas oo sidoo kale ah x=1/5, sidaas darteed waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d08-20.s.s2.model.1: Calaamadda fₙ'(x)=(1−nx)e^(−nx) waxay ka beddelaa + ilaa − marka x=1/n, sidaas darteed marka n=5 x halkaas oo ugu weyn yahay waa 1/5.

l-m-h3-b0d09-03.title: Waa maxay xeerka ku saabsan masaafada ilaa bogga?
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.goal: Ka hel oo sheeg qaabka dhawr tusaale oo masaafada u dhexaysa bar parabola ku taal iyo bogga, oo ku hubi qaabkaas kiis cusub.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.material: Masaafooyinka baraha (1, 2), (4, 4), (9, 6) ee parabola y² = 4x ilaa bogga (1, 0) waa la cabbiray waxaana la helay 2, 5, 10 siday u kala horreeyaan.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay xeerka u dhexeeya isku-duubyada barta iyo masaafadeeda ilaa bogga?
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.r.a: (4, 4), masaafada 5 way ka duwan tahay isku-duubka y ee 4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.r.d: (1, 2) masaafadu waa 2, laakiin tibaaxdani waxay siinaysaa 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s1.explain: Saddexda bar dhammaantood, masaafadu waa isku-duubka x+1. Waxay ku xidhan tahay qeexitaanka parabola: masaafadu waxay la mid tahay masaafada ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda x=−1.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s2.model.0: (1,2) waxay siinaysaa 2, (4,4) waxay siinaysaa 5, (9,6)-na waxay siinaysaa 10, dhammaantood waxay la mid yihiin x+1, sidaas darteed waxaad heli kartaa xeerka masaafad = x+1.
l-m-h3-b0d09-03.s.s2.model.1: Masaafada ilaa tilmaame-xariiqda x=−1 waa x+1, parabola-na masaafooyinka ilaa bogga iyo tilmaame-xariiqdu waa siman yihiin, sidaas darteed masaafada ilaa bogga sidoo kale waa x+1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-10.title: Helista qaabka jaranjaro-yada asymptote-yada
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.goal: Ka hel oo sheeg qaabka dhowr tusaale ee jaranjaro-yada asymptote-yada hyperbola, kadibna qaabkaas ku hubi kiis cusub.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.material: Waxaan helnay asymptote-yada hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1. Marka (a, b) = (2, 3), y = ±3x/2; marka (4, 1), y = ±x/4; iyo marka (1, 5), y = ±5x.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay xeerka u dhexeeya jaranjarada asymptote-yada iyo a, b?
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.r.a: Marka (2, 3), a/b waa 2/3 laakiin dhabtu waa 3/2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s1.explain: Saddexda kiis dhammaantood jaranjaradu waa ±b/a. Asymptote-yadu waa isku mid y=±(b/a)x, oo laga helay x²/a²−y²/b²=0.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s2.model.0: (2,3) wuxuu siinayaa 3/2, (4,1) wuxuu siinayaa 1/4, (1,5) na wuxuu siinayaa 5, dhammaantood waa le'eg yihiin b/a, sidaas darteed xeerku waa jaranjaradu waa ±b/a.
l-m-h3-b0d09-10.s.s2.model.1: Dejinta x²/a²−y²/b²=0 waxay siinaysaa y²=(b²/a²)x², sidaas darteed jaranjaro-yada tusaalayaasha waxay soo baxaan inay le'eg yihiin b/a.

l-m-h3-b0c38-18.goal: Qiyaas xadka tirada iimaylada spam ee la helo maalintii si aad u go'aamiso cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababtaada.

l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.prompt: Xadkee ayaa ka kooban qiyaastii 95% tirooyinka spam ee maalinlaha ah?

l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.r.b: Xadku aad buu u cidhiidhsan yahay. Waa inaad tixgelisaa leexashada caadiga ah 8.7.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.r.c: Waa ka badan yahay 8 jibaar leexashada caadiga ah, aad buu uga ballaaran yahay 95%.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s1.explain: Qiyaastii 95% waa celceliska ±2 leexasho caadi ah. Waa 100±2×8.7, sidaa darteed qiyaastii 83 ilaa 117 iimayl.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s2.model.0: Qaybinta caadiga ah, 95% waa celceliska ±2 leexasho caadi ah, sidaa darteed 100±17.4, qiyaastii 83 ilaa 117 iimayl.
l-m-h3-b0c38-18.s.s2.model.1: 92 ilaa 108 waa ±1 leexasho caadi ah sidaa darteed wuxuu haystaa qiyaastii 68% oo keliya, 25 ilaa 175 na aad buu u ballaaran yahay, sidaa darteed 83 ilaa 117 ayaa ku habboon.

l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.prompt: Dooro xadka ugu habboon ee tirada madaxyada.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.r.b: Waa 5 jeer celceliska ± leexashada caadiga ah, taasoo aad u ballaadhan.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.r.c: Waa celceliska ± hal leexasho caadi ah, sidaas darteed qiyaastii 68% oo keliya ayaa ku dhacda.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.r.d: Xadku aad buu u cidhiidhi yahay sidaas darteed natiijooyinku inta badan way ka baxaan.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s1.explain: Qiyaastii 95% waa celceliska ± 2 jeer leexashada caadiga ah. Maadaama ay tahay 50±10, xadku waa 40 ilaa 60 jeer.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s2.model.0: 95% waa ilaa 2 leexasho oo caadi ah celceliska, 2×5=10 na, sidaas darteed 40 ilaa 60 jeer ayaa ku habboon.
l-m-h3-b0c44-15.s.s2.model.1: 45 ilaa 55 wuxuu qabtaa qiyaastii 68% oo keliya, sidaas darteed si loo qabto 95% waxaad u baahan tahay 40 ilaa 60, taasoo ah laba jeer ballaadh.

l-m-h3-b0c50-04.goal: Qiyaas tirada maalmaha ay qaadanayso dhammaystirka sahanka, dooro cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-h3-b0c50-04.material: Sahanka hal qof wuxuu qaataa 3 daqiiqo. 2 sahamiyeyaal ayaa sahamiya kaliya inta lagu jiro nasashada qadada ee 30 daqiiqo, 200 qof na waa in la sahamiyaa wadar ahaan. Maalmo nasasho ma jiraan.

l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s1.explain: Marka ay tahay 3 daqiiqo qof kasta, hal sahamiye wuxuu sahamiyaa 10 qof 30 daqiiqo. Marka ay jiraan 2 sahamiyeyaal, taasi waa 20 maalintii, sidaa darteed 200÷20=10 maalmood.
l-m-h3-b0c50-04.s.s2.model.0: 1 sahamiye wuxuu sahamiyaa 10 qof 30 daqiiqo, sidaa darteed 2 sahamiyeyaal waxay sameeyaan 20 maalintii, 200÷20=10 maalmood na.

l-m-h3-b0d07-17.material: Qiimaha kee ayaa (eʰ−1)/h u dhowaada marka h u dhow tahay 0? e^0.01≈1.01. Qiyaas adigoo geliya h=0.01.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s1.r.a: Waxaa lagu khaldamay e laftiisa. Tibaaxdu waa (eʰ−1)/h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s1.r.c: Kaliya soo-qaybiyaha ayaa la eegay. U qaybinta h waa laga tagay.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s1.r.d: Waxaa lagu khaldamay 1/h. Soo-qaybiyuhu waa qiyaastii 0.01.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s1.explain: e^0.01−1≈0.01005, oo loo qaybiyo 0.01 waxay siinaysaa qiyaastii 1.005. Waxay ku dhow tahay qiimaha xadka 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s2.model.0: e^0.01≈1.01, sidaas darteed soo-qaybiyuhu waa qiyaastii 0.01, tan oo loo qaybiyo h=0.01 waxay siinaysaa wax ku dhow 1, sidaas darteed waa qiyaastii 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-17.s.s2.model.1: (eʰ−1)/h waxay la mid tahay xaglaha y=eˣ marka x=0, qiimahaasna waa 1, sidaas darteed waa qiyaastii 1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-24.s.s2.model.0: ln waa hoos u dhaadhacsan yahay sidaas darteed wuu ka yar yahay qiimaha taabashada y=x−1 ee 0.1, taas oo macnaheedu yahay ln 1.1 wuu ka yar yahay 0.1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-31.title: Qiyaasidda cabbirka ∫₀¹e^(x²)dx
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.goal: Qiyaas xadka halkaas oo qiimaha ∫₀¹ e^(x²)dx yaal, go'aami cabbir ama xad munaasab ah, oo sharax sababtaada.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.material: Qiyaas cabbirka integral-ka go'an ∫₀¹ e^(x²)dx adigoon isticmaalin antiderivative. Marka 0≤x≤1, 1+x² ≤ e^(x²) ≤ 1+(e−1)x², iyo e≈2.72.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.prompt: Waa kuma xadka halkaas oo qiimaha integral-kan go'an yaal?
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.r.a: Integrand-ku had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan 1, sidaas darteed aagga waa ugu yaraan 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.r.c: Aagga leydiga leh dhererka e, 2.72, waa xad sare, qiimaha dhabta ahna wuu ka yar yahay.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.r.d: Dhererku waa ugu badnaan e dhererka muddaduna waa 1, sidaas darteed ma dhaafi karo 2.72.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s1.explain: Integral-ka 1+x² waa 4/3, integral-ka 1+(e−1)x² na waa qiyaastii 1.57. Sidaas darteed waa ugu yaraan 1.33 oo ugu badnaan 1.57.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s2.model.0: Maadaama e^(x²)≥1+x², aagga waa ugu yaraan 4/3≈1.33, wuxuuna yahay ugu badnaan integral-ka 1+(e−1)x², 1+(e−1)/3≈1.57, sidaas darteed tani way ku habboon tahay.
l-m-h3-b0d07-31.s.s2.model.1: Qalloocku wuxuu ka kacaa dherer 1 ilaa e, sidaas darteed qiimuhu wuu ka weyn yahay 1 wuuna ka yar yahay e. In la dhex-galiyo tibaaxda sare iyo hoose waxay bixisaa 1.33 ilaa 1.57, sidaas darteed tani way ku habboon tahay.

l-m-h3-b0d08-30.title: Qiyaasidda aagga hoos e^(−x²) iyadoo la isticmaalayo trapezoid-yo
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.goal: Qiyaas xadka halkaas oo qiimaha ∫₀²e^(−x²)dx yaal, go'aami cabbir ama xad munaasab ah, oo sharax sababtaada.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.material: Waxaan qiyaasnaa aagga u dhexeeya qalooca y=e^(−x²) iyo xariiqda x, x=0, iyo x=2. Marka x=0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 dhererradu waa qiyaastii 1, 0.78, 0.37, 0.11, 0.02.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.r.a: Xitaa muddada 0 ilaa 0.5 keligeed waxay leedahay aag ka badan 0.4.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.o.c: In ka badan 1 oo ugu badnaan 1.5
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.r.c: Dhererku ma dhaafo 1, wuxuuna sidoo kale dhaqso u yaraadaa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.r.d: Tani waa qiyaas aad u badan, oo ku dhow leydiga dhererkiisu yahay 1, 2×1=2.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s1.explain: Dhererku wuxuu ka yaraadaa 1 ilaa 0.02. Qiyaasidda trapezoid-yo ballaadhkoodu yahay 0.5 waxay bixisaa qiyaastii 0.88.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s2.model.0: Ku darista aagagga trapezoid-yada ballaadhkoodu yahay 0.5 waxay bixisaa 0.5×{(1+0.02)/2+0.78+0.37+0.11}≈0.88, sidaas darteed waa ugu yaraan 0.8 oo ugu badnaan 1.
l-m-h3-b0d08-30.s.s2.model.1: Dhererku wuxuu ka bilaabmaa 1 wuuna dhaqso u yaraadaa, sidaas darteed qaybta ilaa 0.5 waa qiyaastii 0.45 inta kalena waa qiyaastii 0.43. Wadartu waa qiyaastii 0.88, taas oo ku jirta xadkaas.

l-m-h3-b0d08-37.goal: Qiyaas xadka uu ku jiro qiimaha S=1+1/2+…+1/100, go'aami cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababahaaga.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.material: Qiyaas S=1+1/2+…+1/100. Maadaama 1/x ay hoos u dhacayso, S waa ka weyn tahay ∫₁¹⁰¹ dx/x waana ka yar tahay 1+∫₁¹⁰⁰ dx/x (ln 10≈2.3).
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.r.a: Wadarka labada eray ee ugu horreeya oo keliya horeba waa 1.5, waxaana jira 100 eray, sidaas darteed aad bay uga weyn tahay.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa ka yar tahay ln 101≈4.6.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.r.d: Xadka sare waa 1+ln 100≈5.6, sidaas darteed ma dhaafayo 6.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s1.explain: ln 101≈4.6<S<1+ln 100≈5.6. Doorashooyinka dhexdooda, midka ka kooban xadkan waa 4.6 ilaa 5.7.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s2.model.0: S>ln 101≈4.6 iyo S<1+ln 100≈5.6, sidaas darteed xadka ka kooban kan, ugu yaraan 4.6 iyo ugu badnaan 5.7, ayaa ku habboon.
l-m-h3-b0d08-37.s.s2.model.1: ln 100=2·ln 10≈4.6, sidaas darteed S waa ka weyn tahay 4.6 waana ka yar tahay 5.6, taas oo ka dhigaysa 4.6 ilaa 5.7 mid ku habboon.

l-m-h3-b0d09-04.title: Xaddee ayay ku jirtaa wareegga ellipse?
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.goal: Qiyaas wareegga ellipse x²/25 + y²/9 = 1, go'aami cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababahaaga.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.material: Qaabka ellipse-ka x²/25 + y²/9 = 1 wuxuu ka kooban yahay goobo kala-bar-dhexroorkeedu yahay 3 wuxuuna ku jiraa gudaha goobo kala-bar-dhexroorkeedu yahay 5. Isticmaal tan si aad u qiyaasto wareegga ellipse-kan.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah xad ku habboon wareegga? (π≈3.14)
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.r.a: Wuxuu ka gaaban yahay wareegga goobada gudaha ee 18.8, sidaas darteed suurtogal ma aha.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.r.b: Ma ka gaaban karo wareegga goobada kala-bar-dhexroorkeedu yahay 3 (qiyaastii 18.8).
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.r.d: Ma ka dheer karo wareegga goobada kala-bar-dhexroorkeedu yahay 5 (qiyaastii 31.4).
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s1.explain: Wareegga goobada gudaha waa 2π·3≈18.8 wareegga goobada dibadda na waa 2π·5≈31.4, sidaas darteed wareegga ellipse-ku wuxuu u dhexeeyaa labadooda.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s2.model.0: Ellipse-ku wuxuu ka kooban yahay goobada kala-bar-dhexroorkeedu yahay 3, sidaas darteed wareeggiisu wuu ka dheer yahay 18.8, wuxuuna ku jiraa gudaha goobada kala-bar-dhexroorkeedu yahay 5, sidaas darteed wuu ka gaaban yahay 31.4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-04.s.s2.model.1: Marka qalooc kor-u-qaaman uu xidho qalooc kale oo kor-u-qaaman, wuu ka dheer yahay, sidaas darteed wareeggu wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 18.8 iyo 31.4, xadkii koowaad na waa sax.

l-m-h3-b0d09-11.title: Intee ayuu noqonayaa farqiga u dhexeeya asymptote-ka?
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.goal: Qiyaas farqiga y ee u dhexeeya hyperbola iyo asymptote-keeda marka x weyn yahay, go'aami cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababahaaga.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.material: Laantii midig ee hyperbola x² − y² = 1, y≈9.95 marka x=10. Farqiga y ee asymptote-ka y=x waa qiyaastii 0.05. Qiyaas farqiga marka x=100.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah qiyaas ku habboon farqiga marka x=100?
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.r.a: Macnaheedu waa farqigu wuu weynaaday, taasoo aan ku habboonayn macnaha asymptote.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.r.c: Waa isku mid marka x=10, sidaas darteed ma muujiyo u janjeerka u dhowaanshaha.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.r.d: Qiimahani wuxuu qalooca ka sii fogeeyaa asymptote-ka.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.explain: Farqigu waa x−√(x²−1)=1/(x+√(x²−1))≈1/(2x). Marka x=100 waa qiyaastii 0.005, isagoo yaraanaya si ka soo horjeedda x.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s2.model.0: Waa 0.05 marka x=10, marka x noqoto 10 jeer ka weyn, farqigu wuxuu u yaraadaa 1/10, sidaas darteed waa qiyaastii 0.005.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s2.model.1: x−y=1/(x+y) iyo x+y≈200, sidaas darteed farqigu waa qiyaastii 1/200=0.005.

l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.prompt: Qiimee ayaa aan noqon karin cabbirka xoogga natiijada ah?
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.r.b: Xagal munaasab ah, 6, oo u dhexeeya 2 iyo 8, way dhici kartaa.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.r.c: Haddii ay u jeedaan jihooyin is-lid ah, waa 5−3=2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.r.d: Haddii ay u jeedaan isla jiho, waa 3+5=8.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s1.explain: Cabbirka xoogga natiijada ah waa ugu yaraan |5−3|=2 iyo ugu badnaan 3+5=8. 1 waxay ka baxsan tahay xadkan, sidaas darteed ma dhici karto.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s2.model.0: Xoogga natiijada ah waa ugu yar, 2, marka xoogagga u jeedaan jihooyin is-lid ah, ugu weyn, 8, marka ay u jeedaan isla jiho, sidaas darteed 1 waa lagu suurtagal maaha.
l-m-h3-b0d09-20.s.s2.model.1: Haddii aad labada xoog ka samayso saddex-gees, dhinaca haray kama gaaban karo 5−3=2, sidaas darteed xoogga natiijada ah ma noqon karo 1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-35.material: Qaab siman oo leh aag 20 wuxuu sameeyaa xagal 30° dhulka. Iftiin ayaa si toos ah hoos ugu iftiimaya dhulka, waxaadna qiyaasaysaa aagga hooska (mugga toosan). cos30°≈0.87.

l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.a: Taasi waa qiimaha 60°. Marka ay tahay 30° waa ka weyn tahay.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.c: Aagga hooska ma ka weyn karo aagga asalka ah.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.r.d: Waa 20 kaliya marka qaabku is-barbar socdo (0°) dhulka. Marka uu janjeero, wuu yaraadaa.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s1.explain: Aagga mugga toosan waa aagga asalka ah × cosθ. 20×0.87≈17, taasoo ka yar 20.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s2.model.0: Maadaama aagga mugga toosan = aag × cosθ, 20×0.87≈17. Marka qaabku sii janjeero, hooskuna wuu sii yaraadaa, sidaa darteed wuu ka yar yahay 20.
l-m-h3-b0d09-35.s.s2.model.1: 30° waa wax yar ka janjeersan 0°, sidaa darteed hooska wuxuu yaraadaa wax yar. Taasi waa sababta qiyaastii 17, wax yar ka yar 20, ay ku habboon tahay.

l-m-h3-b0d10-07.title: Hyperbola waa qiyaastii intee dherer marka x=3?
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.goal: Qiyaas isu-jiheeyaha y ee bar ku taal hyperbola si aad u go'aamiso cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababahaaga.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.material: Qiyaas isu-jiheeyaha y (togan) ee barta x = 3 ee laanta midig ee hyperbola x² − y²/16 = 1. Isticmaal tirooyin laba-jibbaaran, adigoon isticmaalin xisaabiye.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah qiyaas ku habboon y?
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.a: Haddii y=16, markaas y²=256, taasoo aad uga weyn 128.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.b: y² waa 128. Xididka laba-jibbaaran lama qaadan.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.r.c: Laga bilaabo y²/16=8, y²=128, y na ma aha 8.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s1.explain: Marka x=3, y²/16=9−1=8, sidaas darteed y²=128. Maadaama 11²=121<128<144=12², y wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 11 iyo 12.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.0: y²=128 wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 11²=121 iyo 12²=144, sidaas darteed y wuxuu wax yar ka badan yahay 11, qiyaastii 11.
l-m-h3-b0d10-07.s.s2.model.1: Asymptote-ka y=4x waa 12 marka x=3, qalooca na wax yar ayuu ka hooseeyaa, sidaas darteed waa qiyaastii 11, u dhow 12.

l-m-h3-b0d10-19.goal: Qiyaas qiimayaasha wax-ku-dhigga dot qaadi karo si aad u go'aamiso cabbir ama xad munaasab ah, oo sharax sababtaada.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.material: Waxaa jira vector a oo cabbirkiisu yahay 5 iyo vector b oo cabbirkiisu yahay 2. Xagalka u dhexeeya lama yaqaan. Isticmaal qiyaas si aad u saarto qiime a·b aan noqon karin.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.prompt: Qiimee ayaa a·b aan noqon karin?
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.r.b: Haddii ay is-taagan yihiin, cos90°=0, sidaas darteed wax-ku-dhigga dot waa 0.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.r.c: Waxaa jira xagal leh cosθ=0.9, sidaas darteed 5×2×0.9=9.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s1.explain: a·b=10cosθ iyo −1≤cosθ≤1, sidaas darteed waxay u dhexeysaa −10 iyo 10. 11 waxay ka baxsan tahay xadkan.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s2.model.0: a·b=5·2·cosθ=10cosθ, cosθ-na ma dhaafi karo 1, sidaas darteed wax-ku-dhigga dot waa ugu badnaan 10 oo ma noqon karo 11.
l-m-h3-b0d10-19.s.s2.model.1: Isla jiho, wax-ku-dhigga dot waa ugu weyn 10, sidaas darteed 11 ma dhici karto, wax kasta oo ka timaadda −10 ilaa 10 waa suurtagal.

l-m-h3-b0d10-20.title: Haddii wax-ku-dhigga dot uu yahay 0.8, qiyaastii imisa darajo ayuu yahay xagalka u dhexeeya?
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.goal: Qiyaas xagalka u dhexeeya vector-yada cutubka si aad u go'aamiso cabbir ama xad munaasab ah, oo sharax sababtaada.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.material: Wax-ku-dhigga dot ee vector-ka cutubka u = (1, 0) iyo vector-ka cutubka v waa 0.8. Isticmaal cos30°≈0.87, cos45°≈0.71, iyo cos60°=0.5 si aad u qiyaasto xagalka u dhexeeya.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.prompt: Xadkee ayaa ku haboon xagalka u dhexeeya?
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.r.b: Haddii xagalku ka weyn yahay 45°, cos wuu ka yar yahay 0.71.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.r.c: Haddii xagalku ka yar yahay 30°, cos wuu ka weyn yahay 0.87.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.r.d: Haddii xagalku ka weyn yahay 60°, cos wuu ka yar yahay 0.5.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s1.explain: cosθ wuu yaraadaa marka θ weynaado. cos30°≈0.87>0.8>cos45°≈0.71, sidaas darteed θ waxay u dhexeysaa 30° iyo 45°.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s2.model.0: 0.8 wuu ka yar yahay cos30°≈0.87 wuuna ka weyn yahay cos45°≈0.71, sidaas darteed xagalku wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 30° iyo 45°.
l-m-h3-b0d10-20.s.s2.model.1: Haddii wax-ku-dhigga dot uu yahay 0.8, ka dib cosθ=0.8, marka xagalku weynaado, cos-ku wuu yaraadaa, sidaas darteed xagalku waxaa lagu xidhay u dhexeysa labada qiime tixraac, 30° iyo 45°.

l-m-h3-b0c36-17.title: Safka khaldan ee xalka wax-ku-dhufashada matrix
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.goal: Tallaabo tallaabo raac xalka wax-ku-dhufashada laba matrix, ama silsiladda sababta ilaa saameynta, kadibna hel oo saxdo meesha ugu horreysa ee ay ka khaldanto.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.material: Marka A=(1 2; 3 4) iyo B=(0 1; 1 0), arday ayaa xisaabiyay AB gelitaan gelitaan. Hel safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah safka ugu horreeya ee si khaldan loo xisaabiyay?
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.a: Safka 1 ee A iyo tiirka 1 ee B si sax ah ayaa loo dhufay. Ma aha khalad.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.b: Safka 1 ee A iyo tiirka 2 ee B si sax ah ayaa loo dhufay. Ma aha khalad.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.r.d: Safkani sidoo kale waa khalad, laakiin waxaa jira saf hore oo marka hore khaldamay.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s1.explain: (Saf 2, tiir 1) waa in la dhufo safka 2 ee A iyo tiirka 1 ee B, (0, 1), taasoo siinaysa 3×0+4×1=4. Tiirarka waa la is-dhaafsaday marka la dhufayay.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s2.model.0: Saf 2, tiir 1 waxaa lagu dhufaa tiirka 1 ee B, (0,1), sidaas darteed waa 3×0+4×1=4, laakiin tiirka 2 ayaa la isticmaalay. Sidaas darteed kani waa meesha ugu horreysa ee khaldan oo waa in lagu saxaa 4.
l-m-h3-b0c36-17.s.s2.model.1: Labada safood ee ugu horreeya waa sax, tiirarkana waa la is-dhaafsaday safka saddexaad, sidaas darteed waa inuu ahaadaa 4, ma aha 3.

l-m-h3-b0c36-19.title: Hubinta hal tallaabo oo gradient descent
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.goal: Tallaabo tallaabo raac xisaabinta hal tallaabo oo gradient descent, ama silsiladda sababta ilaa saameynta, kadibna hel oo saxdo meesha ugu horreysa ee ay ka khaldanto.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.material: Isticmaal gradient descent si aad u hesho ugu yaraanta f(x)=x²−6x. Hel safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan ee xal qaadaya hal tallaabo laga bilaabo barta bilowga x=0 oo leh heerka waxbarashada 0.25.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.a: Derivative-ka si sax ah ayaa loo helay. Ma aha khalad.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.b: Beddelidda si sax ah ayaa loo sameeyay. Ma aha khalad.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.o.d: ④ x wuxuu ka fogaaday barta ugu yar ee 3
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.r.d: Natiijadani waxay ka timaaddaa qaladka ③. Waxaa jira saf hore oo khaldan.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s1.explain: x cusub = x − heerka waxbarashada × jaranjarada = 0 − 0.25×(−6) = 1.5. Jaranjarada waa lagu daray, sidaas darteed wuxuu u dhaqaaqay jihada ka soo horjeedda.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s2.model.0: Gradient descent waa inuu ka jaro jaranjarada, laakiin ③ waa lagu daray, sidaas darteed x wuxuu noqday −1.5. U saxo 0−0.25×(−6)=1.5.
l-m-h3-b0c36-19.s.s2.model.1: Haddii jaranjaradu tahay −6, waa inaad midig u aaddaa, sidaas darteed x waa inuu weynaado. Sidaas darteed ③ waa in lagu saxaa 1.5.

l-m-h3-b0c36-20.goal: Tallaabo tallaabo raac xalka helaya cabbirro laga bilaabo matrix jahwareer, ama silsiladda sababta ilaa saameynta, kadibna hel oo saxdo meesha ugu horreysa ee ay ka khaldanto.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.material: Natiijooyinka 200 tijaabo: 40 qof oo buka si sax ah ayaa loo helay togan, 10 qof oo buka ayaa la seegay, 20 qof oo caafimaad qaba ayaa si khaldan loo xukumay togan, 130 qof oo caafimaad qaba na si sax ah ayaa loo helay. Hel safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan ee xalka hal arday.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan?
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.r.b: Isku-darka si sax ah ayaa loo helay. Ma aha khalad.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.r.c: Si sax ah ayaa loo xisaabiyay. Ma aha khalad.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.o.d: ④ Recall waa hooseeya, sidaas darteed dad badan oo buka ayaa la seegay
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.r.d: Gunaanadkani wuxuu ka yimaadaa qiimaha khaldan ee ③. Waxaa jira saf hore oo khaldan.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.explain: Hooseeyaha recall waa tirada dhabta ah ee dadka buka, 40+10=50. 40/50=80%, 40+20 na waa tirada la saadaaliyay togan, taasoo loo isticmaalo saxnaanta (precision).
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s2.model.0: Recall waa saamiga la helay dadka dhabta ah ee buka dhexdooda, sidaas darteed hooseeyuhu waa inuu ahaadaa 40+10=50, laakiin 20 ayaa lagu daray taasna waa khalad; qiimaha saxda ahi waa 80%.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s2.model.1: 40+20 ee ③ lagu isticmaalay waa tirada la saadaaliyay togan, sidaas darteed waa hooseeyaha precision. U saxo recall 40/50=80%.

l-m-h3-b0c37-17.goal: Raac tallaabooyinka xal xisaabinaya cosine u dhexeeya laba vector, ama silsiladdiisa sababta iyo saamaynta, si isku xigta, hel meesha ugu horreysa ee ay khaldanto, oo hagaaji.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.material: Kani waa xalka arday oo helaya cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|) ee a=(3,4) iyo b=(4,−3). Hel safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.r.a: Wax-ku-dhufashada dot si sax ah ayaa loo xisaabiyay. Ma khaldana.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.r.b: Cabbirka si sax ah ayaa loo xisaabiyay. Ma khaldana.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.r.d: Hooseeyuhu waa khalad, laakiin wax-ku-dhufashada dot waa 0, sidaas darteed qiimuhu waa isku mid. Waxaa jira saf khaldan oo ka horreeya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.explain: |b|=√(4²+(−3)²)=√25=5. Labajibaarku waa togan calaamad kasta, sidaas darteed waa inaad isku darto.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.0: Maadaama (−3)²=9, |b| waa √(16+9)=5, laakiin ③ 9 ayaa laga jaray oo waxay noqotay √7, sidaas darteed ③ waa khaladka ugu horreeya.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.1: Labajibaarka qaybaha dhammaantood wuu ka dhigaa togan, sidaas darteed waa inaad isku darto, laakiin waa la jaray, sidaas darteed ③ u hagaaji 5.

l-m-h3-b0c38-05.goal: Raac tallaabooyinka xalka wax-ku-dhigga AB ee laba matriis, ama silsiladda sababta iyo saameynta, si isku xigta, ka dibna hel oo sixiix meesha ugu horreysa ee ay ka khaldan tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.material: A=[1 2; 3 4], B=[0 1; 1 0] (; macnaheedu waa safar cusub). Xalka AB: Safka 1: xubnaha (1,1)=1·0+2·1=2. Safka 2: xubnaha (1,2)=1·1+2·0=1. Safka 3: xubnaha (2,1)=3·1+4·0=3. Safka 4: xubnaha (2,2)=3·0+4·1=4.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s1.r.a: Safka 1 iyo tiirka 1 si sax ah ayaa loo isku dhuftay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s1.r.b: Safka 1 iyo tiirka 2 si sax ah ayaa loo isku dhuftay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s1.r.d: Safka 4 sidoo kale waa khalad, laakiin horeba waa ka khaldantay safka 3.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s1.explain: Xubnaha (2,1) waa 3·0+4·1=4, oo ka timid safka 2 ee A oo lagu dhufto tiirka 1 ee B. Safka 3 wuxuu isticmaalay tiirka 2 ee B.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s2.model.0: Xubnaha (2,1) waa inuu noqdaa safka 2 ee A oo lagu dhufto tiirka 1 ee B, laakiin safka 3 wuxuu isticmaalay tiirka 2, sidaas darteed waa khalad. Marka la sixiixo, waa 4.
l-m-h3-b0c38-05.s.s2.model.1: Natiijooyinka safafka 3 iyo 4 waa la is-beddelay, sidaas darteed khaladka ugu horreeya waa safka 3. (2,1)=4 iyo (2,2)=3 waa sax.

l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s1.r.d: Gunaanadku waa natiijo kaliya oo ka timid khaladka safkii hore.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s2.model.0: Wadarta fursadda ah inuu leeyahay 'free' waa in lagu helaa adigoo ku dhufanaya saamiyada kooxaha ka dibna isku darista, sidaas darteed safka 2 waa khalad. Waa 0.12+0.04=0.16.
l-m-h3-b0c38-11.s.s2.model.1: 0.6 iyo 0.05 waa saamiyo kooxo kala duwan gudahood ah, sidaas darteed ma isku darin kartid si fudud. Waa inaad ku dhufataa spam 20% iyo caadi 80% ka dibna isku darto.

l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.d: Xisaabinta dhigaysa a=b waa sax. Dhibaatadu waxay ku jirtaa safkii hore.

l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.o.d: Wuxuu ku gunaaday in 2 jeer hawo ayaa loo baahan yahay
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.r.d: Tani si fudud ayay u raacdaa natiijada xisaabinta safkii hore.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s1.explain: (2r)³=8r³. Haddii dhererku noqdo 2 jeer ka weyn, mugga wuxuu noqdaa 2³=8 jeer, sidaas darteed 8 jeer hawo ayaa loo baahan yahay.
l-m-h3-b0c49-21.s.s2.model.0: (2r)³=2³·r³=8r³, sidaas darteed mugga waa 8 jeer, 8 jeer hawo-na waa loo baahan yahay.

l-m-h3-b0c50-30.s.s1.r.d: Wuxuu akhriyay celceliska ku jira shuruudaha sidiisa oo kale, sidaas darteed waa sax.

l-m-h3-b0d07-02.material: Xalka lim(√(n²+3n)−n): (1) Ka saar xididka: 3n/(√(n²+3n)+n) (2) U qaybi n: 3/(√(1+3/n)+1) (3) Maadaama 3/n→3, 3/(√4+1)=1 (4) Xadku waa 1
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.o.a: Safka (1): halkaas oo xididka laga saaray
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.a: Korreeyuhu wuxuu noqonayaa (n²+3n)−n²=3n, sidaa darteed ka saaridda xididku waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.o.b: Safka (2): halkaas oo loo qaybiyey n
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.b: Tibaaxda ka dib u qaybinta hoosaadka iyo korreeyaha n waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.o.d: Safka (4): halkaas oo gabagabada lagu qoray
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.r.d: (4) si fudud ayuu u sii wadaa qiimaha (3), sidaa darteed maaha meesha ugu horreysa ee qaldanta.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s1.explain: Marka n→∞, 3/n→0. Sidaa darteed 3/(1+1)=3/2 waa xadka saxda ah.
l-m-h3-b0d07-02.s.s2.model.0: Marka n sii weynaado, 3/n wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0, ma aha 3, sidaa darteed safka (3) waa qalad. Si sax ah waa 3/(1+1)=3/2.

l-m-h3-b0d07-16.material: Farqinta y=ln(x²+1): (1) Ha noqdo u=x²+1, sidaas darteed y=ln u (2) dy/du=1/u (3) du/dx=2x (4) y'=1/u+2x
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s1.o.d: Safka (4): meesha labada la isku daray
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s1.explain: Xeerka silsiladdu waa ku dhufasho. y'=(1/u)·2x=2x/(x²+1).
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s2.model.0: Farqinta shaqo isku-dhafan waxay ku dhufataa dy/du iyo du/dx halkii ay ku dari lahayd, sidaas darteed (4) waa khalad. y'=2x/(x²+1).
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s2.model.1: Xeerka silsiladdu waa (1/u)×2x, sidaas darteed ma aha inaad isku darto; ku dhufashadu waxay siinaysaa 2x/(x²+1).

l-m-h3-b0d07-23.goal: Raac si isku xigxig ah xalka, ama silsiladda sababta iyo natiijada, ee lagu helayo xaglaha xariiqda taabata barta (1,1) ee x²+xy+y²=3, hel meesha ugu horreysa ee ay ka khaldanto, oo hagaaji.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.material: Xalka xaglaha xariiqda taabata barta (1,1) ee x²+xy+y²=3: (1) Farqi labada dhinac: 2x+y+xy'+2yy'=0 (2) y'(x+2y)=2x+y (3) y'=(2x+y)/(x+2y) (4) (1,1), y'=3/3=1

l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.o.c: Safka (3): meesha y' loo qoray qaybin ahaan
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.r.c: (3) waxay ka timid qaybinta (2), sidaas darteed ma aha meesha ugu horreysa ee khaldan.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.r.d: Gelinta (1,1) iyo xisaabinta waa sax iyadoo lagu salaynayo safkii hore.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.explain: Dhaqaajinta (2x+y) dhinaca midig waxay beddelaysaa calaamadda, sidaas darteed y'=−(2x+y)/(x+2y). Xaglaha waa −1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s2.model.0: Dhaqaajinta 2x+y dhinaca midig ee (1) waxay calaamadda ka dhigaysaa −, sidaas darteed (2) waa khalad, xaglaha saxda ahna waa −3/3=−1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.o.d: Sheegidda in xagalku yahay af-baaxad sababtoo ah cosθ waa taban
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.r.d: Gunaanadka ah in xagalku yahay af-baaxad marka cosθ<0 waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d09-21.s.s1.explain: Hooseeyuhu waa in la ku dhufto: |a||b|=√5·√10=5√2. Maadaama cosθ=−1/(5√2)<0, gunaanadku waa isku mid, laakiin tibaaxdu waa khalad.

l-m-h3-b0d09-37.material: Kani waa xal lagu helayo isla'egta goobo leh A(1, 2, 3) iyo B(5, 2, 3) sidii labada dhammaad ee dhexroor. ① Bartamuhu waa barta dhexe ee AB, (3, 2, 3) ② AB=4 ③ Garab-dhexaadku waa r=4 ④ (x−3)²+(y−2)²+(z−3)²=16

l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s1.r.b: Barta dhexe ee dhexroorku waa bartamaha, sidaas darteed tani waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s1.r.c: Farqiga isku-duubyada x waa 4, sidaas darteed AB=4 waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s1.explain: AB waa dhexroor, sidaas darteed garab-dhexaadku waa 2. Isla'egta waa in lagu hagaajiyaa (x−3)²+(y−2)²+(z−3)²=4.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s2.model.0: AB=4 waa dhexroorka, sidaas darteed garab-dhexaadku waa badhkiis, 2. Tallaabada ③, oo qortay r=4, waa khalad, dhinaca midigna wuxuu noqonayaa 4, ma aha 16.
l-m-h3-b0d09-37.s.s2.model.1: Goobo dhexroorkeedu yahay 4, masaafada laga bilaabo bartamaha ilaa A waa 2, sidaas darteed gelinta (1,2,3) waxay siinaysaa 4, dhinaca midigna 4 waa sax.

l-m-h3-b0d10-08.goal: Raac tallaabooyinka xalka (ama silsiladda sababta iyo saameynta) ee helista isla'egta hyperbola laga bilaabo xarumaha iyo dhererka dhidibka hore, hel meesha ugu horreysa ee ay ka khaldanto, oo saxdo.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.material: Kani waa xal helaya hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 oo xarumaheedu yihiin (±5, 0) dhidibkeeda hore na dhererkiisu yahay 6. ① Dhidibka hore 2a=6, a=3 ② Xarunta c=5 ③ b²=a²+c²=9+25=34 ④ x²/9 − y²/34 = 1
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.a: Dhererka dhidibka hore waa 2a, sidaas darteed a=3 waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.b: Laga bilaabo xarumaha (±5, 0), c=5 waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.r.d: Hooseeyaha 9 ee hoos x² waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s1.explain: Hyperbola, c²=a²+b², sidaas darteed b²=c²−a²=25−9=16. Isla'egtu waa x²/9−y²/16=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.0: Hyperbola wuxuu leeyahay c²=a²+b², sidaas darteed b²=c²−a² waa inuu noqdaa 16. Qorista ③ iyadoo la isticmaalay ku darid waa khalad.
l-m-h3-b0d10-08.s.s2.model.1: Haddii b²=34, markaas c²=9+34=43, xarumuhuna ma noqon lahaayeen (±5,0). Sidaas darteed 34 waa khalad, 16 na waa sax.

l-m-h3-b0d10-09.material: Kani waa xal helaya k si xariiqda y = x + k u taabato parabola y² = 4x. ① (x+k)² = 4x ② x² + (2k−4)x + k² = 0 ③ Waa taabasho, sidaas darteed D>0, taasoo ah −16k+16>0 ④ Sidaas darteed k<1

l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s1.explain: Marka ay taabato, waxaa jira hal isgoys, sidaas darteed D=0. Laga bilaabo −16k+16=0, k=1.
l-m-h3-b0d10-09.s.s2.model.0: Inay taabato macnaheedu waa hal isgoys, sidaas darteed D=0 ayaa loo baahan yahay. D>0 waa marka xariiqdu ku kulanto qalooca laba bar. U saxo k=1.

l-m-h3-b0c33-24.goal: U sheeg shuruudda halkaas oo dakhliga iyo kharashku isku mid noqdaan qaab kale (tibaax, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leeyihiin.

l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.r.a: Waxay ku dartay kharashka doorsoomaha dakhliga. Kharashka doorsoomuhu wuxuu ku jiraa dhinaca kharashka.

l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.r.d: Calaamadda kharashka go'an waa la rogay. Waa in lagu darsadaa kharashka.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s1.explain: Dakhliga 5,000q = kharashka 2,000,000+3,000q; haddii 3,000q dhinaca kale loo wareejiyo waxaa soo baxaya (5,000−3,000)q=2,000,000.
l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s2.model.0: Laga bilaabo 5,000q=2,000,000+3,000q, haddii 3,000q dhinaca bidix loo wareejiyo waxaa soo baxaya (5,000−3,000)q=2,000,000.

l-m-h3-b0c35-06.goal: Dib u qor "heerka kororka soo celiya qiimaha hoos u dhacay 20%" qaab kale (qaacido, shax, sawir, erayo) oo sharax sababta ay macne isku mid u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.material: Qiimaha shay wuxuu hoos u dhacay 20%. Qiimaha hoos u dhacay waa 0.8 jeer qiimaha asalka ah. Ka fikir ku dhufasho ahaan boqolkiiba imisa ayaad ku sii kordhisaa qiimaha hoos u dhacay si aad u hesho qiimaha asalka ah.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay heerka kororka si laga soo noqdo qiimaha hoos u dhacay ilaa qiimaha asalka ah?
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad hoos u dhaca 20% u qaadatay kororka isku cabbir ah si aad dib ugu noqoto. Saldhiggu waa kala duwan yahay.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad u akhrisay qiimaha 0.8 jeer laftiisa sida heerka kororka.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad isku qasatay kordhinta ilaa 1.2 jeer iyo kordhinta 120%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s1.explain: 0.8×(1+r)=1, sidaas darteed 1+r=1.25, taasoo ah r=25%. Saldhiggu wuxuu isu beddelaa qiimaha hoos u dhacay.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s2.model.0: Si 0.8 uu u noqdo 1 marka lagu dhufto tiro, waa inay noqotaa 1.25 jeer, sidaas darteed waa inaad kordhisaa 25%.
l-m-h3-b0c35-06.s.s2.model.1: Cadadka hoos u dhacay waa isku mid, laakiin saldhiggu hadda wuu ka yar yahay, 0.8 jeer asalka, sidaas darteed heerka kororku ma aha 20% ee waa 0.2÷0.8=25%.

l-m-h3-b0c35-14.material: Badeecadi waxay leedahay kharash go'an oo 5,000 won, qiimo iib oo 800 won shay kasta, iyo kharash beddelmaha ah oo 300 won shay kasta. Ku muuji erayo tirada shayada (barbar-dhigga faa'iidada) ee dakhliga guud iyo kharashka guud ay isle'eg yihiin.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.prompt: Sharaxaadee ayaa macnaheeda isku mid ah barbar-dhigga faa'iidada?
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.a: Tirada shayada, oo mid kasta kasbanaya 800 won, daboosha 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.r.a: Ma ka goyn kharashka beddelmaha ah ee 300 won.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.b: Tirada shayada, oo mid kasta ka reebaya 500 won, daboosha kharashka go'an ee 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.c: Tirada shayada, oo mid kasta ka reebaya 300 won, daboosha 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad kharashka beddelmaha ah u qaadatay faa'iido.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.o.d: Tirada shayada marka dakhligu gaaro 5,000 won
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad eegtay dakhliga oo keliya adigoon la barbar dhigin kharashka guud.
l-m-h3-b0c35-14.s.s1.explain: Lacagta ka haraysa shay kasta waa 800−300=500 won. Marka 5,000÷500=10 shay la gaaro, dakhliga iyo kharashku waa isle'eg yihiin 8,000 won.

l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s1.r.b: Safafka iyo tiirarka waa la is-dhaafsaday, sidaas darteed safka ugu horreeya wuxuu noqday kaydka tufaaxa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s1.r.c: Isku xigga tiirarka waa la is-dhaafsaday, sidaas darteed tiirka ugu horreeya wuxuu noqday kaydka miro-lugaha.
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s1.explain: Safka ugu horreeya waa Dukaanka A (3 tufaax, 2 miro-lugaha) safka labaadna waa Dukaanka B (1 tufaax, 4 miro-lugaha), sidaas darteed waa (3 2; 1 4).
l-m-h3-b0c37-21.s.s2.model.0: Safka ugu horreeya, qor 3 iyo 2, tufaaxa iyo miro-lugaha Dukaanka A sidaas isku xigga, safka labaad-na, qor 1 iyo 4 ee Dukaanka B, sidaas darteed macnaheedu waa isku mid miiska.

l-m-h3-b0c37-23.material: Shaqada muujinaysa khaladka moodelka waa J(w)=2(w−1)²+5. w waa qiimaha aad hagaajiso J-na waa khaladka. Eeg tibaaxda oo ku dhig erayo ku saabsan qiimaha ugu yar.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.prompt: Dooro jumladda macnaheedu isku mid yahay tibaaxda.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.o.a: Khaladku wuxuu ugu yar yahay w=−1, wuuna 5
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.r.a: Qiimaha ka dhigaya w−1 mid le'eg 0 waa 1, ma aha −1.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.o.b: Khaladku wuxuu ugu yar yahay w=1, wuuna 5
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.o.c: Khaladku wuxuu ugu yar yahay w=1, wuuna 2
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad isku qaldeen isku-dhufteyaasha 2 iyo qiimaha ugu yar.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.o.d: Khaladku wuxuu ugu yar yahay w=5, wuuna 1
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad isku qaldeen joogtada 5 iyo qiimaha w.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s1.explain: 2(w−1)² wuxuu ugu yar yahay w=1, halkaas oo uu yahay 0. Kadib J=5, sidaas darteed qiimaha ugu yar waa 5.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s2.model.0: (w−1)² wuxuu ugu yar yahay w=1, halkaas oo uu yahay 0, J-na wuxuu noqdaa 5, sidaas darteed waa isku mid in la yiraahdo khaladku wuxuu ugu yar yahay marka w=1.
l-m-h3-b0c37-23.s.s2.model.1: Eray labajibaaran waa 0 ama ka weyn, sidaas darteed haddii w=1 ay ka dhigto 0, 5-ka haray waa qiimaha ugu yar, taas oo macnaheedu yahay isku mid.

l-m-h3-b0c37-24.goal: U beddel 'precision 80%' qaab kale (tibaax, miis, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macnaha isku mid u tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.material: 50-ka kiis ee moodelku u yiri togan dhexdooda, 40 ayaa dhab ahaan togan ahaa. Natiijadan waxaa loo yaqaan precision 80%. Waxaad rabtaa inaad macnaheeda ku dhigto erayo.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.prompt: Dooro jumladda macnaheedu isku mid yahay precision 80%.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.o.a: Wuxuu helay 80% ee kuwa togan ee dhabta ah
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.r.a: Taasi waa recall. Hooseeyihiisu waa kuwa togan ee dhabta ah.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.o.b: Wuxuu si sax ah u xukumay 80% kiisaska oo dhan
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.r.b: Taasi waa saxnaan. Waxay sidoo kale ku jirtaa kiisaska caadiga ah ee si sax ah loo helay.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.o.c: 80% ee kiisaska uu u yiri togan waa dhab ahaan togan
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.r.d: Saamiga kuwa togan waa qiime ka duwan precision.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s1.explain: Precision waa saamiga togan-dhabta ah ee kuwa moodelku u yiri togan dhexdooda. Waa 40 ee 50, sidaas darteed 80%.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s2.model.0: Hooseeyuhu waa 50-ka kiis ee moodelku u yiri togan, kor-yeeluhuna waa 40-ka togan ee dhabta ah ee kuwaas dhexdooda, sidaas darteed macnaheedu waa 80% ee wicitaannada togan waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0c37-24.s.s2.model.1: Precision wuxuu muujiyaa sida wicitaan togan loo kalsoonaan karo, sidaas darteed waa isku mid in la yiraahdo 80% ee la yiri togan waa dhab.

l-m-h3-b0c38-06.title: Dib u qorista nidaam isla'egyo sida isla'eg matriis
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.goal: Dib u qor qaabka wax-ku-dhigga matriis ee nidaam isla'egyo matalaad kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan dib u qorno nidaamka isla'egyada 2x+y=5, x−y=1 sida isla'eg matriis oo ah qaabka (matriiska isku-dhufashooyinka)(x; y)=(dhinaca midig). Semicolon (;) wuxuu muujiyaa safar cusub oo matriis ah.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.prompt: Isla'eg matriis kee ayaa isla macnaha leh nidaamka isla'egyada asalka ah?
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.r.a: Isku-dhufashada y ee safka labaad waa -1, laakiin waxaa loo qoray +1.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.r.b: Isku xigga 5 iyo 1 ee dhinaca midig waa la is-beddelay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s1.explain: U qor isku-dhufashooyinka isla'eg kasta hal safar, dhinaca midigna u qor tiir isla isku xigga. x=2, y=1 waxay buuxinayaan labada isla'eg.
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s2.model.0: Safka koowaad wuxuu leeyahay isku-dhufashooyin 2, 1, safka labaad wuxuu leeyahay 1, -1, dhinaca midigna waa 5, 1, sidaas darteed waa [2 1; 1 -1][x; y]=[5; 1].
l-m-h3-b0c38-06.s.s2.model.1: Dhigista x=2, y=1 isla'egta matriis waxay bixisaa 5 iyo 1 safafka, sidaas darteed waxay isla macno leedahay nidaamka isla'egyada asalka ah.

l-m-h3-b0c38-15.title: U beddelidda qaacidada qiimaha la filayo erayo
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.goal: Dib u qor qiimaha la filayo 1×0.2+2×0.5+3×0.3 matalaad kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.material: Dhibcaha su'aalaha yar X waxay soo baxaan 1 dhibic fursad 0.2 ah, 2 dhibcood 0.5 ah, iyo 3 dhibcood 0.3 ah. Qiimaha la filayo waa E(X)=1×0.2+2×0.5+3×0.3=2.1. Dooro tibaax kale oo isla macno leh.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.prompt: Tibaaxdee ayaa leh isla macnaha E(X)?
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.o.a: Barta dhexe ee u dhexaysa dhibicda leh fursadda ugu weyn iyo tan ugu yar
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.r.a: Ma helin kartid qiime dhexe cabbirka fursadaha.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.o.b: Dhibicda ugu badan soo baxda, 2 dhibcood
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.r.b: Taasi waa mode. Qiimaha la filayo waa celcelis miisaan leh.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.o.c: Celceliska fudud ee 1, 2, iyo 3 dhibcood, 2 dhibcood
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.r.c: Taasi waa celcelis fudud oo aan lagu miisaamin suurtagalnimada.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.o.d: Celceliska marka 2, 5, iyo 3 ka mid ah 10 qof ay helaan 1, 2, iyo 3 dhibcood
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s1.explain: Haddii 10 qof dhexdooda 2 ay helaan 1 dhibic, 5 ay helaan 2 dhibcood, 3 na ay helaan 3 dhibcood, celcelisku waa (2+10+9)÷10=2.1, isku mid.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s2.model.0: U beddelidda suurtagalnimooyinka saamiyada dadka waxay siinaysaa (1×2+2×5+3×3)÷10=2.1, sidaa darteed waxay la macno tahay qiimaha la filayo.
l-m-h3-b0c38-15.s.s2.model.1: Qiimaha la filayo waa celcelis lagu miisaamay suurtagalnimada, sidaa darteed wuxuu siinayaa isla qiime celceliska 10 qof ee isla saamiyada.

l-m-h3-b0c38-23.title: Ku sheegidda khaladka celceliska labajibbaaran erayo
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.goal: Dib u qor khaladka celceliska labajibbaaran (1/n)Σ(saadaal−dhab)² qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isku macno u tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.material: Khaladka celceliska labajibbaaran (MSE) waa (1/n)Σ(qiimaha la saadaaliyey−qiimaha dhabta ah)². Saadaalinnada [2,5,4] iyo qiimayaasha dhabta ah [3,5,2], waa (1+0+4)÷3=5/3. Aan qaacidadan erayo ku qorno.
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.s.s1.prompt: Tibaaxdee ayaa leh macne la mid ah MSE?
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.s.s1.r.a: Calaamadaha khaladaadku way is baabi'inayaan. Labajibbaarista way maqan tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.s.s1.r.b: Celceliska, u qaybinta tirada n, way maqan tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.s.s1.r.d: Waa inaad khalad kasta labajibbaartaa kadibna aad isku darto. Kala horreyntu way duwan tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.s.s1.explain: Labajibbaar khalad kasta kadibna qaado celceliska. Calaamaduhu is baabi'in maayaan khaladaadka waaweynna waxay tiriyaan wax badan.
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.s.s2.model.0: Qaacidadu waxay labajibbaartaa khaladaadka oo u qaybisaa n, sidaa darteed waa celceliska khaladaadka labajibbaaran.
l-m-h3-b0c38-23.s.s2.model.1: Kaliya ku darista khaladaadka −1 iyo 2 waxay ka dhigaysaa inay is baabi'iyaan, sidaa darteed marka hore labajibbaar kadibna qaado celceliska.

l-m-h3-b0c41-22.s.s2.model.0: 36 km waa 36000 m 1 saac-na waa 3600 thaniyadood, sidaas darteed 36000÷3600=10 m/s.
l-m-h3-b0c41-22.s.s2.model.1: Si loo beddelo m waxaad ku dhufataa 1000, si loo beddelo thaniyadoodna waxaad u qaybisaa 3600, sidaas darteed tibaaxdani waxay muujinaysaa isla xawaaraha.

l-m-h3-b0c42-28.title: Halkee ayay ku urursan yihiin celcelisyada muunadda?
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.goal: Dib u sheeg celceliska muunadda dadka leh celcelis 50 iyo leexasho caadi ah 10 qaab kale (qaacido, shax, sawir, erayo) oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.material: Dhibcaha imtixaanku waxay leeyihiin celcelis 50 iyo leexasho caadi ah 10. Celcelisyada muunadaha 25 arday ee si kadis ah loo doortay waxaa loo qaybiyaa celcelis 50 iyo leexasho caadi ah 2. U qor xaqiiqadan erayo.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.o.a: Qiyaastii 95% dhibcaha ardayda waxay u dhexeeyaan 46 iyo 54 dhibcood
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.r.a: Xadka celcelisyada muunadda waxaa loo akhriyay xadka dhibcaha shakhsiyeed.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.o.b: Haddii aad doorato 25 arday mar kasta, celcelisku had iyo jeer waa saxda 50 dhibcood
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.r.b: Celceliska muuqaalka wuxuu wax yar isbeddelaa marka kasta oo aad dooranayso.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.o.c: Inta badan celceliska muuqaallada 25 arday waa 46 ilaa 54 dhibcood
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.o.d: Celceliska muuqaalka had iyo jeer wuxuu ka yar yahay celceliska dadweynaha 2 dhibcood
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.r.d: 2 waa leexashada caadiga ah ee celceliska muuqaalka, ma aha farqiga celceliska dadweynaha.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s1.explain: Leexashada caadiga ah ee celceliska muuqaalka waa 2, sidaas darteed qiyaastii 95% waa 50±4, taas oo ah 46 ilaa 54 dhibcood. Dhibcaha shakhsiga ah aad ayey u kala firdhisan yihiin.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s2.model.0: Leexashada caadiga ah ee celceliska muuqaalka waa 2, sidaas darteed inta badan waxay isugu uruuriyaan ±4 gudahood celceliska 50, taas oo ah inta u dhexeysa 46 iyo 54 dhibcood.
l-m-h3-b0c42-28.s.s2.model.1: Tani ma aha dhibcaha shakhsiga ah laakiin waa qaybinta celceliska 25 arday, sidaas darteed firdhisku wuu yaraadaa waxayna isugu uruuriyaan 46 ilaa 54 dhibcood.

l-m-h3-b0c42-31.title: Sidee u dib u qori lahayd maqaalka "khatarta 2 jeer"?
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.topic: Khatarta xidhiidhka iyo tirooyinka saafiga ah
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.goal: Dib u sheeg cinwaanka maqaalka "khatarta saameynta dhinaca 2 jeer" qaab kale (qaacido, miis, sawir, erayo) oo sharax sababta ay isku macne u tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.material: Cinwaanka maqaalka: "Qaadashada dawadan waxay la macno tahay khatar 2 jeer ah oo saameyn dhinac ah!" Jidhku wuxuu leeyahay, "Dadka la kulmay saameyn dhinac ah waxay ka kacay 3 ilaa 6 1 koox oo ah 10,000."
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.prompt: Jumladee ayaa si ugu sax ah u gudbisa isla xaqiiqada cinwaanka?
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.o.a: 6% dadka qaata ayaa la kulma saameyn dhinac ah
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.o.b: Ka mid ah 1 koox oo ah 10,000 qof, 6 ayaa si cusub ula kulmay saameyn dhinac ah
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.r.b: 6 qof waa wadarka la kulmay, kororkuna waa 3 qof.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.o.c: 1 ka mid ah 2 qof ee qaata ayaa la kulma saameyn dhinac ah
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.r.c: Waa 6÷10000, ma aha 1 ka mid ah 2 qof.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.o.d: Saameynta dhinaca waxay ka kacday 3 ilaa 6 1 koox oo ah 10,000 qof, kororka 3 qof
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s1.explain: "2 jeer" waa saamiga 3 qof oo noqda 6 qof. Tirooyinka saafiga ah ahaan waa kordhin 3 qof 1 koox oo ah 10,000.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s2.model.0: Waxay ka tagtay 3 ilaa 6, sidaas darteed waa 2 jeer, laakiin 3 qof oo dheeraad ah oo kaliya ayaa saameysan 1 koox oo ah 10,000, sidaas darteed waa inaadan u akhrin sidii khatartu aad u kordhay.
l-m-h3-b0c42-31.s.s2.model.1: Hadalka xidhiidhka ah ee "2 jeer" waxaa loo qori karaa 3 qof oo noqda 6 1 koox oo ah 10,000, kororkuna waa 3 qof, sidaas darteed jumladan waa sax.

l-m-h3-b0c43-15.goal: U beddel xariiqda wakhtiga jimicsiga socodka iyo kalooriyada la gubay qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.material: Xariiqda dib-u-celinta ee wakhtiga jimicsiga socodka x daqiiqo iyo kalooriyada la gubay y kcal waxay soo baxday y=30+8x.
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.prompt: Weedhee ayaa isla macnaha leh isla'egtan?
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.o.a: Haddii aad jimicsato 30 daqiiqo, waxaad gubtaa 8 kcal
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.r.a: Wuxuu akhriyay meelaha 30 iyo 8 si khaldan.
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.o.b: Haddii kalooriyada la gubay ay tahay 8 kcal, waxaad jimicsatay 30 daqiiqo
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.r.b: Wuxuu akhriyay jihada x iyo y dib-u-rog.
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.o.c: Haddii aad jimicsato, had iyo jeer waxaad gubtaa 8 kcal
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.r.c: Waa xidhiidh la saadaaliyay oo celcelis ah, ma aha “had iyo jeer.”
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.o.d: 1 daqiiqad jimicsi kasta, kalooriyada la saadaaliyay ee la gubay waxay kor u kacdaa 8 kcal
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s1.explain: Xagal-qaadiska 8 macnaheedu waa marka x kor u kaco 1, y la saadaaliyay wuxuu kor u kacaa 8, 30-na waa qiimaha la saadaaliyay marka x=0.
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s2.model.0: Mar kasta oo x kor u kaco 1 daqiiqo, qiimaha isla'egtu wuxuu noqdaa 8 ka weyn, sidaas darteed macnaheedu waa kalooriyada la saadaaliyay waxay kor u kacdaa 8 kcal 1 daqiiqad jimicsi kasta.
l-m-h3-b0c43-15.s.s2.model.1: Xagal-qaadisku waa qaddarka y la saadaaliyay isu beddelo marka x kor u kaco 1, sidaas darteed in loo akhriyo kor u kac 8 kcal waxay isla macno leedahay.

l-m-h3-b0c43-31.s.s2.model.1: Kororka 20% wuxuu ku salaysan yahay 80 ka dib hoos u dhaca, sidaa darteed ma ku soo laabto bilowga wuxuuna noqdaa 96.

l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.o.a: Heerka taageerada runta ah waxaa lagu qiyaasaa inuu yahay qiyaastii 49% ilaa 55%

l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.r.c: Waa kalsooni 95%, sidaa darteed ma odhan kartid "hubaal".
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.o.d: Heerka taageeradu wuxuu kor u kacay ama hoos u dhacay 3% laga bilaabo 52%
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.r.d: ±3 qiyaas boqolkiiba waa khaladka sahanka, ma aha cadad isbeddel.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s1.explain: 52% ±3 qiyaas boqolkiiba waa 49% ilaa 55%, kanina waa xadka la qiyaasay ee heerka taageerada dadweynaha.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s2.model.0: 52% ±3 qiyaas boqolkiiba waa 49% ilaa 55%, maadaama kanina yahay xadka la qiyaasay ee saamiga dadweynaha, wuxuu leeyahay isla macne hadalkii asalka ahaa.
l-m-h3-b0c44-23.s.s2.model.1: Ka jarista iyo ku darista xadka khaladka saamiga muunadda waxay siinaysaa xadka, sidaa darteed waxay la mid tahay in la yiraahdo heerka taageerada runta ah waxaa lagu qiyaasaa 49% ilaa 55%.

l-m-h3-b0c45-25.title: Waa maxay saamiga soo noqnoqodyada xargaha dhererkoodu leeyahay saamiga 2:3?
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.goal: Dib u qor saamiga dhererka laba xarig sida saamiga soo noqnoqodyada qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macne isku mid u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.material: Laba xarig oo isku shay ah oo isku xajmi ah, marka xarigga ka gaaban yahay, soo noqnoqodku wuu weynaadaa, soo noqnoqodkuna wuxuu u dhigan yahay si ka soo horjeedda dhererka. Saamiga dhererka xarigga gaaban iyo kan dheer waa 2:3.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay saamiga soo noqnoqodyada (xarigga gaaban : xarigga dheer)?
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.r.a: Waad laba-jibbaartay. Dhigmo-ka-soo-horjeedku macnaheedu ma aha laba-jibbaarid.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad isticmaashay saamiga dhererka sidiisa oo kale. Sababtoo ah waa ka soo horjeeda, waa inaad rogtaa.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.r.d: Dhererradu way kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed soo noqnoqodyadu way kala duwan yihiin.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s1.explain: Soo noqnoqodku wuxuu u dhigan yahay si ka soo horjeedda dhererka, sidaas darteed waad rogtaa saamiga. Xarigga gaaban wuu ka sarreeyaa, sidaas darteed waa 3:2.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s2.model.0: Dhigmo-ka-soo-horjeedku macnaheedu waa wax-ku-dhufashadu joogto ayay tahay, sidaas darteed saamiga dhererka 2:3 wuxuu noqdaa saamiga soo noqnoqodka 3:2.
l-m-h3-b0c45-25.s.s2.model.1: Xarigga gaaban wuxuu sameeyaa cod ka sarreeya, sidaas darteed dhinaca leh soo noqnoqodka weyn waa xarigga gaaban, saamiguna waa 3:2.

l-m-h3-b0c45-26.title: Isla'eg ay seddex-geesood siman iyo laba-jibbaaran is-kula kulmaan daloolo la'aan
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.goal: Dib u qor 3 seddex-geesood siman iyo 2 laba-jibbaaran oo ku kulma hal gees qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macne isku mid u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.material: Hal xagal oo seddex-geesood siman waa 60° hal xagal oo laba-jibbaaran na waa 90°. Waxaa jira qaab halkaas oo 3 seddex-geesood siman iyo 2 laba-jibbaaran ay ku kulmaan hal gees daloolo la'aan.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.prompt: Isla'egta kee ayaa muujinaysa inay ku kulmaan daloolo la'aan?
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.a: Haddii aad xagal kasta ku darto hal mar oo keliya, waa 150°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad is-dhaafsatay tirooyinka qaababka. Isku-darku wuu ka badan yahay 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ku dartay tirada qaababka oo keliya, ma aha cabbirka xagallada.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s1.explain: Xagallada waa inay isku darmaan wareeg buuxa 360° si loo helo daloolo la'aan. 180°+180°=360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s2.model.0: Xagallada bar hareeraheeda waa inay noqdaan 360°, sidaas darteed qor haddii 60°×3 ku dar 90°×2 ay samaynayso 360°.
l-m-h3-b0c45-26.s.s2.model.1: Waxay noqotaa 180°+180°=360°, sidaas darteed isla'egta ku dhufata xagal kasta tirada qaababkiisa oo isku daraysa waxay muujinaysaa inay ku kulmaan daloolo la'aan.

l-m-h3-b0c46-23.goal: Dib u qor soo noqnoqoshada nooto laba octave ka sarreysa qaab kale (tibaax, miis, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isku macne u tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.material: Kor u kacidda hal octave waxay soo noqnoqoshada ku dhufataa 2. Waxaa jira nooto laba octave ka sarreysa nooto 110Hz ah.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.prompt: Tibaaxdee ayaa si sax ah u muujinaysa soo noqnoqoshada nootadan?
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.a: Tani waa qiimaha kor u kacidda hal octave oo keliya (220Hz).
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay octave kasta u qaadatay 4 jeer. Waa 2 jeer, laba mar.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.r.d: Waxay kor u kacdaa ku dhufasho, ma aha ku darid.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s1.explain: Octave kasta waa 2 jeer, sidaas darteed laba octave waa 2×2=4 jeer, 110×4=440Hz-na.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s2.model.0: Octave kasta wuxuu ku dhufanayaa 2, sidaas darteed laba octave waxaa loo qori karaa 4 jeer, taas oo ah 2 oo lagu dhuftay laba jeer.
l-m-h3-b0c46-23.s.s2.model.1: Wuxuu ka tagaa 110Hz ilaa 220Hz, 220Hz ilaa 440Hz-na, sidaas darteed waa isku mid 110×2×2=440.

l-m-h3-b0c46-26.title: U beddelidda saddex-geesood afar-geesood isku bed ah
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.goal: Dib u qor saddex-geesood salkiisu yahay 8 dhererkiisuna yahay 5 qaab kale (tibaax, miis, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isku macne u tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.material: Xisaabta Bariga hore waxay helaysay bedka iyadoo la jarayo qaabab oo qaybaha la dhaqaajinayo (mabda'a isku-dhammaystirka dibadda-gudaha). Waxaad rabtaa inaad gooyso saddex-geesood salkiisu yahay 8 dhererkiisuna yahay 5 oo mar kale ku dhejiso sidii afar-geesood qumman oo ballaciisu yahay 8.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay dhererka afar-geesoodka qumman ee isku bedka ah?
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.a: Haddii dhererku isku mid ahaado, bedku wuxuu noqonayaa laba-laab.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.b: Haddii dhererka la labalaabo, bedku wuxuu noqonayaa afar jeer.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.r.d: Tani waxay bedka saddex-geeska 20 u qortay sidii dhererka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s1.explain: Bedka saddex-geeska waa 8×5÷2=20. Dhererka afar-geesoodka qumman ee ballaciisu yahay 8 waa 20÷8=2.5, taas oo ah badhka dhererka.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s2.model.0: Haddii aad gooto qaybta sare ee seddex-geesoodka oo aad dhaqaajiso, wuxuu noqonayaa afar-geesood toosan oo dherer-kor-u-qaadkiisu yahay badh, sidaas darteed dherer-kor-u-qaadku waa badhka 5, taasoo ah 2.5.
l-m-h3-b0c46-26.s.s2.model.1: Qaybinta bedka 20 ballaadhka 8 waxay siinaysaa 2.5, sidaas darteed wuxuu noqdaa afar-geesood toosan oo leh bed isku mid ah.

l-m-h3-b0c47-23.title: Sidee loo dib u qori karaa isla'egta saamiga dahabka ah qaab kale?
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.goal: Dib u qor isla'egta saamiga dahabka ah φ qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isku macno u tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.material: Saamiga dahabka ah φ (qiyaastii 1.618) wuxuu buuxiyaa φ = 1 + 1/φ. Raadi isla'eg kale oo isku macno ah tan.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.prompt: Dooro isla'egta la macno ah tan asalka ah.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.a: Way kala duwan tahay, sababtoo ah φ²≈2.618 iyo φ−1≈0.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.b: Waxay run tahay kaliya marka φ=2. Laakiin φ waa qiyaastii 1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.c: Haddii aad φ ka tirtirto labada dhinac, waxaad heleysaa 0=1, taasoo been ah.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.explain: Ku dhufo labada dhinac φ waxaadna heleysaa φ² = φ + 1. Haddii φ≈1.618, labada dhinac waa qiyaastii 2.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.0: Ku dhufashada labada dhinac φ waxay siinaysaa φ²=φ+1, sidaa darteed waxay la macno tahay isla'egta asalka ah.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.1: Ku darista φ=1.618 waxay siinaysaa φ²≈2.618 iyo φ+1=2.618, sidaa darteed labada isla'eg waxay siinayaan isla qiime.

l-m-h3-b0c47-24.title: Sidee u beddeli kartaa tirada lammaanayaasha bakaylaha xeer hal-xariiq ah?
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.topic: Xiriirka soo noqnoqda ee isku xigga Fibonacci
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.goal: Dib u qor sida tirada lammaanayaasha bakaylaha u kobcaan xeer hal-xariiq ah qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, ama erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isku macno u tahay.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.material: Lammaane bakaylo ah ayaa dhasha, ka dib laba bilood na wuxuu leeyahay lammaane cusub bil kasta. Bakaylaha waligood ma dhintaan. Tirada lammaanayaasha bil kasta waxay u kordhaan 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ….
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa si sax ah u beddelaya kobacan xeer hal-xariiq ah?
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.a: Ku dhufashadu waxay siinaysaa 1, 1, 1, …. Taasi waa ka duwan tahay tirooyinka la bixiyey.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.o.b: Bishan = bishii hore + laba bilood ka hor
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.c: Wuxuu u kordhaa sida 1, 2, 4, 8. Taasi waa ka duwan tahay 1, 1, 2, 3 ee la bixiyey.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.r.d: Wuxuu kordhaa sida 1, 2, 3, 4. Taasi way ka duwan tahay lambarrada la bixiyay.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s1.explain: Tirada lammaanaha dhashay waxay la mid tahay tirada lammaanaha laba bilood ka hor. Sidaas darteed 1+1=2, 1+2=3, 2+3=5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s2.model.0: Lammaanaha bishan waa lammaanaha bishii hore oo lagu daray lammaanaha dhashay, tirada lammaanaha cusubna waxay la mid tahay tirada lammaanaha laba bilood ka hor, sidaas darteed xeerkaasi waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0c47-24.s.s2.model.1: Ku darista labada lambar ee hore waxay siinaysaa lambarka xiga, sida 2+3=5 iyo 3+5=8, sidaas darteed labada xeerba isku macne ayey leeyihiin.

l-m-h3-b0c47-25.s.s1.explain: Wareeg 180° ah wuxuu beddelaa calaamadaha x iyo y labadaba. Taasi waxay la mid tahay (3, 2) oo noqonaysa (−3, −2).

l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.r.b: Waa 2 ka mid ah 1000. Ma aha 2 ka mid ah 10.
l-m-h3-b0c48-23.s.s1.o.c: Heerka calaamaduhu wuxuu ka hoos dhacay 0.2% ilaa 0.1%

l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.r.b: Dadaalku wuxuu weydiinayaa wax ka duwan darajooyinka.
l-m-h3-b0c50-02.s.s1.o.c: Weydii haddii ay u muuqato inay fiicantahay in wax la barto waqti dheer

l-m-h3-b0c50-26.goal: U beddel bayaanka ah in isku-darka saddex tiro dhamaystiran oo isku xigta uu yahay isku-dhufashada 3 qaab kale (qaacido, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macne isku mid u leeyihiin.

l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s1.prompt: Tibaaxda kee ayaa muujinaysa inay run tahay kiis kasta?
l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s1.r.a: Waa hal tusaale oo keliya, sidaas darteed kama muujiso kiis kasta.
l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s1.r.b: Tibaaxda saddex tiro oo isku xigta waa khalad.
l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s1.r.c: Xisaabinta isku-darku waa khalad, sidaas darteed ma aha isku-dhufashada 3.
l-m-h3-b0c50-26.s.s1.explain: Saddex tiro dhamaystiran oo isku xigta waa n, n+1, n+2, isku-darkuna waa 3n+3=3(n+1), sidaas darteed waa isku-dhufashada 3 n kasta.

l-m-h3-b0d07-05.title: U beddelidda isugeynta qayb n/(n+1) eray guud
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.goal: U muuji ereyga guud aₙ ee isugeynta qayb Sₙ=n/(n+1) qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isku macno u yihiin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.material: Isugeynta taxanaha Σaₙ laga bilaabo ereyga koowaad ilaa ereyga n-aad waa Sₙ=n/(n+1). U muuji isla taxanahaas ereyga guud aₙ.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.prompt: Kee si sax ah u muujiya aₙ?
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.a: S₂−S₁=1/6, laakiin tibaaxdani waxay siinaysaa a₂=2/3, sidaa darteed way ka duwan tahay.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.r.c: Marka n=1 wuxuu siinayaa 1/4, laakiin a₁=S₁=1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s1.explain: aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁. n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n=1/{n(n+1)}, wuxuuna sidoo kale u shaqeeyaa n=1, isagoo siinaya 1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.0: Ereyga guud waa farqiga isugeynta qaybta ee dariska ah, Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁, sidaa darteed dhigidda n/(n+1)−(n−1)/n hoosaad guud waxay siinaysaa 1/{n(n+1)}.
l-m-h3-b0d07-05.s.s2.model.1: S₁=1/2 iyo S₂−S₁=1/6, geliddana qiimayaasha 1/{n(n+1)} waxay siinayaan 1/2 iyo 1/6, sidaa darteed waa isla taxane.

l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s1.prompt: Tibaaxdee ayaa isku macne ah f'(2)=3?

l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s1.r.d: Hooseeyuhu waa inuu noqdaa isbeddelka h. Ma aha 2+h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s1.explain: Qiimaha derivative-ka waa xadka saamiga isbeddelada, {f(2+h)−f(2)}/h. Hooseeyuhu waa isbeddelka h ee x.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s2.model.0: Qiimaha derivative-ka waa xadka saamiga isbeddelka y ee isbeddelka h ee x, sidaas darteed waa xadka {f(2+h)−f(2)}/h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-18.s.s2.model.1: Soo-qaybiyuhu waa f(2+h)−f(2) hooseeyuhuna waa inuu noqdaa isla isbeddelka h si loo helo celceliska heerka isbeddelka, sidaas darteed tibaaxdan waxay isku macne tahay f'(2).

l-m-h3-b0d07-25.title: U beddelidda muddo kordhaysa sinnaan-la'aan
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.goal: U muuji muddada halkaas oo f(x)=x·e^(−x) uu kordho qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leeyihiin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.material: Si aad u hesho muddada halkaas oo f(x)=x·e^(−x) uu kordho, u beddel f'(x)>0 sinnaan-la'aan fudud.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.prompt: Sinnaan-la'aanta kee ayaa isla macnaha leh f'(x)>0?
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.r.b: Calaamadda derivative-ka e^(−x) waa la seegay.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.o.c: e^(−x) > 0, taas oo ah x oo dhan
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.r.c: Xitaa haddii e^(−x) togan yahay, waa inaad sidoo kale eegtaa calaamadda 1−x.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.r.d: Calaamaddu waa la rogay, sidaas darteed muddooyinka kordhaya iyo dhimaya waa la is-beddelay.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.explain: f'(x)=e^(−x)−x e^(−x)=(1−x)e^(−x) iyo e^(−x)>0, sidaas darteed f'>0 macnaheedu waa 1−x>0, taas oo ah x<1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s2.model.0: Xeerka wax-ku-dhigga f'(x)=(1−x)e^(−x), e^(−x)-na had iyo jeer waa togan, sidaas darteed f'>0 waxay le'eg tahay 1−x>0, taas oo ah x<1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s2.model.1: Maadaama e^(−x)>0, calaamadda waxaa go'aamisa 1−x. Sidaas darteed f'(x)>0 macnaheedu waa isku mid x<1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-32.title: U beddelidda xadka taxane integral go'an
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.goal: U muuji lim Σ(2/n)f(1+2k/n) qaab kale (isla'eg, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leeyihiin.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.material: f waa joogto. U qor lim(n→∞) Σ(k=1~n) (2/n)·f(1+2k/n) sida integral go'an.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.prompt: Integral-ka go'an kee ayaa le'eg xadkan?
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.a: 2/n waa ballaadhka muddada, sidaas darteed gooni uma dhufto 2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.b: Qiimaha gudaha f waa 1+2k/n, sidaas darteed x wuxuu ka bilaabmaa 1 ilaa 3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.c: Dhererka muddada waa (2/n)×n=2 wuxuuna ka bilaabmaa 1, sidaas darteed wuxuu ku dhammaadaa 3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.explain: 2/n waa ballaadhka, x=1+2k/n-na wuxuu ka dhaqaaqaa 1 ilaa 3. Sidaas darteed waa ∫₁³ f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.0: Isu uruurinta n qaybood oo ballaadhkoodu yahay 2/n waxay bixisaa dherer 2, x=1+2k/n-na wuxuu ka bilaabmaa 1 ilaa 3, sidaas darteed waa ∫₁³ f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.1: Marka k=1, x wax yar ayuu ka weyn yahay 1, marka k=n-na, x=3, sidaas darteed muddadu waa [1,3]. Taasi waa sababta ay u le'eg tahay integral-kan go'an.

l-m-h3-b0d07-38.material: f waa joogto. Isticmaal beddelka u=2x si aad u qorto ∫₀³ f(2x)dx sida isku-dhafan u.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s1.prompt: Tibaaxda kee ayaa leh qiime isku mid ah?
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s1.r.b: Marka x=3, u=6, sidaas darteed dhammaadka xadkana waa inuu is-beddelaa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s1.r.d: 1/2 ee la dhufan lahaa marka dx loo beddelayo du way maqan tahay.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s1.explain: Haddii u=2x, markaas du=2dx, sidaas darteed dx=du/2, marka x ka bilaabmo 0 ilaa 3, u wuxuu ka bilaabmaa 0 ilaa 6.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s2.model.0: Laga bilaabo du=2dx, dx=du/2, haddii x=3 markaas u=6, sidaas darteed wuxuu noqdaa (1/2)∫₀⁶ f(u)du.
l-m-h3-b0d07-38.s.s2.model.1: Xadku wuxuu u beddelmaa 0 ilaa 6 dx na waa badhka du, sidaas darteed tibaaxdii asalka ahayd waxay le'eg tahay (1/2)∫₀⁶ f(u)du.

l-m-h3-b0d08-05.s.s1.r.c: 3ⁿ waxay ku jirtaa hooseeyaha, sidaas darteed saamiga guud waa 1/3.

l-m-h3-b0d08-05.s.s1.explain: Eraygii n=1 waa 2/3, eraygii xigana 2/9 waa 1/3 jeer taas. Isku-darku waa (2/3)/(1−1/3)=1.

l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.o.c: Tirada isgoysyada garaafyada y=eˣ/x (x≠0) iyo y=k
l-m-h3-b0d08-25.s.s1.o.d: Tirada isgoysyada garaafyada y=x/eˣ iyo y=k

l-m-h3-b0d08-31.title: Dib u qorista ∫x f'(x)dx iyadoo la isticmaalayo integral-garaynta qaybaha
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.goal: Dib u sheeg ∫₀¹ x f'(x)dx qaab kale (tibaax, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay isla macnaha u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.material: f waa kala duwanaan karta [0,1] f'-na waa joogto. Isticmaal integral-garaynta qaybaha si aad dib ugu qorto ∫₀¹ x f'(x)dx sida tibaax isticmaalaysa f.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s1.r.a: Isku-dhafka qaybaha waa uv−∫u'v, taas oo ah ka-jarid.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s1.r.b: Maadaama x lagu dhufanayo, si toos ah uma noqoto ∫f'=f(1)−f(0).
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s1.r.c: Calaamaddu waa mid lidka ah. [x f(x)]₀¹=f(1) ayaa horreeya.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s1.explain: Dejinta u=x, v'=f' waxay siinaysaa [x f(x)]₀¹−∫₀¹ f(x)dx=f(1)−∫₀¹ f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s2.model.0: Dejinta u=x, v'=f'(x) iyo isticmaalka isku-dhafka qaybaha waxay siinaysaa [x f(x)]₀¹−∫₀¹ f(x)dx, sidaas darteed waxay noqotaa f(1)−∫₀¹ f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d08-31.s.s2.model.1: [x f(x)]₀¹=f(1)−0 iyo u'=1, sidaas darteed isku-dhafka hadhay waa ∫f(x)dx. Sidaas darteed isla qiimaha waa f(1)−∫₀¹ f(x)dx.

l-m-h3-b0d09-06.title: U beddelidda "masaafooyinku waa siman yihiin" isla'eg
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.goal: Dib u sheeg shuruudda ah masaafooyinka xarunta iyo hagaha (directrix) ay siman yihiin qaab kale (tibaax, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macne isku mid u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.material: Urur barta P(x, y) ee isla masaafada ka fog xarunta F(0, 2) iyo hagaha y = −2 waa parabola. U beddel shuruuddan hal isla'eg.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.prompt: Isla'egta kee ayaa muujinaysa isla macnaha?
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.a: Marka 4py, p=2, sidaas darteed waa 8y, ma aha 4y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.b: Parabola-ku wuxuu leeyahay dhidibka y sida dhidibkiisa, sidaas darteed x iyo y waa la is-dhaafsaday.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.c: Xarunta waxay ku taal kor, sidaas darteed wuxuu kor u furmaa. Astaanta way ka duwan tahay.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.explain: Laba-jibbaarinta labada dhinac ee √(x²+(y−2)²)=|y+2| waxay siinaysaa x²+y²−4y+4=y²+4y+4, taasoo ah x²=8y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s2.model.0: Qorista "masaafooyinku waa siman yihiin" sida isla'eg waxay siinaysaa x²+(y−2)²=(y+2)², fududaynta na waxay siinaysaa x²=8y, sidaas darteed macne isku mid ayay leeyihiin.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s2.model.1: Haddii quluqulku yahay asalka xaruntuna tahay (0,2), markaas p=2, sidaas darteed x²=4py=8y, kor u furmaha na astaantu sidoo kale waa sax.

l-m-h3-b0d09-13.goal: Dib u sheeg ellipse lagu sawiray xadhig qaab kale (tibaax, shax, sawir, erayo), oo sharax sababta ay macne isku mid u leedahay.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.material: Labada dhammaad ee xadhig 10 cm ah ayaa lagu xidhay laba musbaar F(3,0) iyo F′(−3,0), oo 6 cm u kala fog, qalin na wuxuu xadhigga ka dhigayaa mid xaddiga ah wuxuuna sawiraa hal mar hareerahooda. U beddel qalloocan isla'eg.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah isla'egta qalooca la sawiray?
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.r.b: 9 waa c². Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad isticmaasho b²=a²−c²=16.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.r.c: Dhidibka weyn wuxuu ku yaal dhidibka x, sidaas darteed hooseeyaha 25 waa inuu raaco x².
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.r.d: 10 iyo 6 waa dhererka xadhigga iyo masaafada u dhexeysa musbaarrada. Ma aha a² ama b².
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s1.explain: PF+PF′=10, sidaas darteed a=5; masaafada musbaarradu waa 6, sidaas darteed c=3; iyo b²=25−9=16.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s2.model.0: Dhererka xadhigga waa PF+PF′=10, sidaas darteed 2a=10, a=5, c=3, iyo b²=16, taasoo siinaysa x²/25+y²/16=1.
l-m-h3-b0d09-13.s.s2.model.1: Barta la sawiray waxay marayaan (±5,0) dhidibka x iyo (0,±4) dhidibka y, sidaas darteed waa isla ellipse-ka isla'egtiisuna waa x²/25+y²/16=1.

l-m-h3-b0d09-38.material: Isla'egta goobo waxaa loo fidiyay sida x² + y² + z² − 2x + 4y − 6z + 5 = 0. Dib u qor qaab lagu arki karo bartamaha iyo garab-dhexaadka isla markiiba.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.a: Calaamadaha isku-duubyada bartamaha waa la rogay.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.b: Dhinaca midig waa laba-jibbaarka garab-dhexaadka, sidaas darteed waa 9, ma aha 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.c: Dhinaca midig si khaldan ayaa loo sameeyay iyadoo lagu daray ereyga joogtada ah 5.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.explain: Dhammaystirka laba-jibbaarada waxay siinaysaa (x−1)²+(y+2)²+(z−3)²=1+4+9−5=9. Bartamuhu waa (1, −2, 3) garab-dhexaaduna waa 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.0: Dhammaystirka laba-jibbaarka x, y, iyo z mid kasta wuxuu ku daraa 1+4+9 oo wuxuu dhaqaajiyaa 5, sidaas darteed dhinaca midig wuxuu noqonayaa 9, waana isla isla'egta.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.1: Dhaqaajinta dhinaca midig 9 bidix iyo fidinta waxay siinaysaa −2x+4y−6z iyo joogtada 1+4+9−9=5, sidaas darteed waa la mid isla'egta asalka ah.
