l-m-h3-b0c34-26.s.s1.o.c: Isdiiwaangelin: way fududahay in la joojiyo marka aad rabto
l-m-h3-b0c34-26.s.s1.r.c: Haddii aad qorshaynayso inaad isticmaasho 2 sano, waa inaad ku isbarbar dhigtaa wadarta kharashka.
l-m-h3-b0c34-26.s.s1.explain: Isdiiwaangelin 24 bilood ah waa 20,000×24=480,000 won. Iibsashada 360,000 won waa ka yar (iibsashadu waa ka fiican tahay laga bilaabo 18 bilood).
l-m-h3-b0c34-26.s.s2.model.0: Isdiiwaangelintu waa 20,000 won×24 bilood=480,000 won iibsashaduna waa 360,000 won, sidaas darteed iibsashadu waxay ku kacdaa wax ka yar haddii aad isticmaasho 2 sano.

l-m-h3-b0c34-27.s.s1.r.d: Labaduba waa heerarka kororka (%), sidaas darteed si toos ah ayaa loo isbarbar dhigi karaa.

B: 'Immisa ayaad uga qanacsan tahay quraacda dugsiga maanta? (Dooro laga bilaabo aad uga qanacsan tahay ilaa aad uga qanacsan tahay)'

l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.r.a: Su'aashu waxay hore u maleyneysaa aan-qanacsanaan oo jawaabta u jiheysaa hal dhinac.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.o.b: A, sababtoo ah jumladdu way ka gaaban tahay
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.r.b: Dhexdhexaadnimadu way ka muhiimsan tahay dhererka.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.o.c: Labada su'aalood waa isku mid, sababtoo ah mawduucu waa isku mid
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.r.c: Xitaa isla mawduuca, jumladdu waxay u jiheysaa jawaabta.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s1.o.d: B, sababtoo ah waa la qoray si dhexdhexaad ah wuxuuna leeyahay doorashooyin labada dhinac ah

l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s2.model.0: A wuxuu hore u go'aamiyaa in quraacdu dhadhan xun tahay, sidaas darteed jawaabuhu waxay u janjeeraan aan-qanacsanaan, taasoo ka dhigaysa B dhexdhexaadka ah mid ku habboon.
l-m-h3-b0c42-04.s.s2.model.1: B waa ka wanaagsan yahay sababtoo ah ka jawaabayaasha waxay dooran karaan meel kasta oo u dhexeysa aad uga qanacsan ilaa aad uga qanacsan tahay, sidaas darteed fikradahooda dhabta ah way muuqdaan.

l-m-h3-b0d07-27.material: A wuxuu yidhi lim(x→0)(e^(3x)−1)/x waa 3, B-na wuxuu yidhi waa 1. A: Aan yeelno 3x=t, u beddel 3·(eᵗ−1)/t. B: Maadaama (eʰ−1)/h→1, si fudud waa 1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.o.a: B waa sax. Qaacidada xadka ayaa si toos ah loo isticmaalay.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.r.a: Hooseeyuhu waa x, sidaas darteed ma qaadato qaabka (eʰ−1)/h.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.o.b: Labaduba waa sax. Qiimayaashu waa isku mid.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.r.c: Marka x=0.001, qiimuhu waa qiyaastii 3.0045, taas oo ku dhow 3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.o.d: A waa sax. Hooseeyaha ayaa sidoo kale la waafajiyay 3x.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s1.explain: e^(3x)−1 wuxuu leeyahay qaabka halkaas oo 3x uu qaato doorka h, sidaas darteed hooseeyuhu waa inuu sidoo kale noqdaa 3x. 3·(e^(3x)−1)/(3x)→3·1=3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s2.model.0: Hooseeyuhu waa inuu noqdaa 3x si loo helo qaabka (eʰ−1)/h, sidaas darteed in lagu dhufto oo loo qaybiyo 3 waxay bixisaa 3·1=3, taas oo ka dhigaysa A mid sax ah.
l-m-h3-b0d07-27.s.s2.model.1: Marka x=0.001, (e^0.003−1)/0.001≈3.0045, taas oo ku dhow 3, sidaas darteed 1 ee B waa khalad 3 ee A-na waa sax.

l-m-h3-b0d08-06.s.s1.o.a: A waa sax. Tibaaxda la kala qaybiyay, hore iyo dambe way is-tirtiraan.

l-m-h3-b0d08-06.s.s1.r.b: Natiijooyinku way kala duwan yihiin, 3/2 iyo 3/4.
l-m-h3-b0d08-06.s.s1.o.c: B oo keliya ayaa sax ah. Tibaaxda la kala qaybiyay waa la mid eraygii asalka ahaa
l-m-h3-b0d08-06.s.s1.o.d: Labaduba waa khalad. Isku-darku wuu kala fogaadaa
l-m-h3-b0d08-06.s.s1.r.d: Isku-darrada qayb ahaaneed waxay u dhowaadaan 3/4, sidaas darteed wuu isu-dhowaadaa.

l-m-h3-b0d09-25.goal: Isbarbar dhig laba hab oo lagu ballaariyo cabbirka farqiga vector-yada, ama laba sheegasho, dooro tan ka fiican, oo sharax sababtaada.
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.material: X wuxuu qoray |a−b| sida |a|−|b|, Y-na wuxuu qoray |a−b|²=|a|²−2a·b+|b|². Dhig a=(1,0), b=(0,1) si aad u hesho kee sax ah.
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.o.a: Y: Wax-ku-dhigga dot waa 0, sidaas darteed qaacidadu ma run aha
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.r.a: Xitaa marka wax-ku-dhigga dot uu yahay 0, qaacidadu waa run sababtoo ah |a|²+|b|²=2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.o.b: Y: Labada dhinac waa isku mid, maadaama 2 = 1 − 0 + 1
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.o.c: X: |a|−|b| way ka fudud tahay, sidaas darteed waa sax
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.r.c: Xitaa haddii ay fudud tahay, qiimaha waa inuu sax noqdaa. Tusaalahan, 0≠√2.
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.o.d: X: Waxaad heshaa cabbirka vector adigoo ka jarraya
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.r.d: Cabbirka farqiga waxaa laga helaa qaybaha, ma aha sida |a|−|b|.
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s1.explain: |a−b|²=|(1,−1)|²=2, |a|²−2a·b+|b|²=1−0+1=2. Tibaaxda X waxay bixisaa 0, sidaas darteed way kala duwan yihiin.
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s2.model.0: Tibaaxda Y waxay run tahay sida 2=1−0+1, laakiin tibaaxda X waxay bixisaa √2=1−1=0, taas oo khalad ah, sidaas darteed Y waa sax.
l-m-h3-b0d09-25.s.s2.model.1: Cabbirka farqigu maaha |a|−|b|, sidaas darteed X waa khalad. Habka Y ee labajibaarka iyo isticmaalka wax-ku-dhigga dot had iyo jeer wuu shaqeeyaa.

l-m-h3-b0d07-08.title: Deeq: weyn sannadka koowaad, wadarta xadka gudihiisa
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.goal: Miisaan shuruud kasta oo is khilaafsan ee cadadka sannadka koowaad ee deeq sannad kasta yaraata, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.material: Deeq ayaa la siiyaa sannad kasta. Sannadka koowaad waa a (10,000 won), sannad kasta oo xigana waa r jibaar kii hore. Xataa haddii ay weligeed socoto, wadartu waa inay ahaataa ugu badnaan 100 × 10,000 won, sannadka labaad waa inuu ahaadaa ugu yaraan 70% ee sannadka koowaad, sannadka koowaadna waa inuu ahaadaa kan ugu weyn.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.prompt: Qorshee ayaa buuxiya shuruud kasta isagoo sannadka koowaad ka dhigaya kan ugu weyn?
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.a: Wuxuu buuxiyaa shuruudaha, laakiin sannadka koowaad waa la weynayn karaa wadarta 100 × 10,000 won gudaheeda.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.c: Wadartu waa 35/0.3≈116.7 × 10,000 won, taasoo ka badan 100 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.r.d: Wadartu waa 100 (cutubyo 10,000 won), laakiin sannadka labaad waa 60%, taasoo ka yar 70%.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s1.explain: Wadartu waa a/(1−r)≤100 iyo r≥0.7. Marka r=0.7, a≤30, sidaa darteed 30 × 10,000 won sannadka koowaad ayaa ugu weyn.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s2.model.0: r waa inuu ahaadaa ugu yaraan 0.7 wadartuna a/(1−r)≤100, sidaa darteed a=30 marka r=0.7 waa ugu badnaan, taasoo ka dhigaysa qorshahan mid ku habboon.
l-m-h3-b0d07-08.s.s2.model.1: Kor u qaadista r waxay yareysaa a≤100(1−r), hoos u dhigista r na waxay jebisaa shuruudda 70%, sidaa darteed r=0.7, a=30 waa heshiiska.

l-m-h3-b0d07-13.goal: Miisaan dhammaan shuruudaha is khilaafsan ee saamiga r ee kubbadda kor ugu booddo, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.material: Kubbad laga dhaafay dherer 3m ah ayaa mar kasta kor u booddata r jeer dhererkii hore. Dabacsanaanta r waa inay noqotaa ugu yaraan 0.5, wadarka masaafada la socdaalay ilaa ay istaagto-na waa inuu noqdaa ugu badnaan 15m. Intaas dhexdeeda, ka dhig r mid ugu weyn.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.prompt: Qorshee ayaa buuxiya shuruud kasta isla markaana ka dhigaya r kan ugu weyn?
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.r.a: Waxay buuxisaa shuruudaha, laakiin r waa la sii kor u qaadi karaa ilaa 2/3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.r.b: Dabacsanaantu waa ka yar tahay 0.5, sidaas darteed waxay jebisaa shuruudaha.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.r.d: Wadarka masaafada la socdaalay waa 21m, taas oo ka badan 15m.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s1.explain: Marka laga eego wadarka masaafada 3(1+r)/(1−r)≤15, r≤2/3. r ugu weyn ee buuxiya shuruudaha waa 2/3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s2.model.0: Wadarka masaafada 3(1+r)/(1−r) waa inuu noqdaa ugu badnaan 15, sidaas darteed r≤2/3, si r loo weynaysiiyona, 2/3 ayaa ugu habboon.
l-m-h3-b0d07-13.s.s2.model.1: Haddii r=0.75 waa 21m, taas oo xadka ka badan, haddii r=2/3 waa si sax ah 15m, sidaas darteed kani waa qorshaha leh dabacsanaanta ugu weyn xadka gudihiisa.

l-m-h3-b0d07-35.title: Dooridda dhererka madal wareeg-jir ah
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.goal: Dhererka madal laga sameeyay wareejinta y=√x, miisaan dhammaan shuruudaha is khilaafsan, dooro heshiiska ugu fiican, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.material: Madal ayaa laga sameeyay wareejinta qalooca y=√x (0≤x≤h) agagaarka xariiqda x (cutub: cm). Mugga waa inuu noqdaa ugu yaraan 50π cm³, dhererka h waa inuu noqdaa ugu badnaan 12 cm, h-na marka ay ka yar tahay, alaabta ka yar ayaa la isticmaalaa.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.prompt: h kee ayaa buuxiya shuruudaha oo isticmaala alaabta ugu yar?
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.r.a: Mugga waa 32π, taas oo ka yar 50π.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.r.c: Wuxuu buuxiyaa shuruudaha, laakiin wuxuu isticmaalaa alaab ka badan h=10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.r.d: Dhererku wuxuu dhaafayaa xadka 12 cm (mugga waa 98π).
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s1.explain: Mugga waa π∫₀^h x dx=πh²/2. Si uu u noqdo ugu yaraan 50π, h≥10 ayaa loo baahan yahay, h ugu yar, h=10, na waa kan ugu habboon.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s2.model.0: Laga bilaabo mugga πh²/2≥50π, h≥10, sidaas darteed dhererka 12 ama ka yar gudihiisa, h-ga isticmaala alaabta ugu yar waa 10.
l-m-h3-b0d07-35.s.s2.model.1: h=8 mugga aad buu u yar yahay, h=12 iyo 14-na waxay isticmaalaan alaab badan ama dhaafaan xadka, sidaas darteed h=10, oo si dhow u buuxisa shuruudda mugga, waa kan ugu habboon.

l-m-h3-b0d08-35.title: Dhererka iyo agabka qaybta jaranka riixka buundada
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.goal: Dhererka a ee qaybta jaranka riixka y=a·x(2−x), miisaan dhammaan shuruudaha is khilaafsan, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.material: Qaybta jaranka riixka buundadu waa y=a·x(2−x) (0≤x≤2, cutubka m). Dhererka bartamuhu a waa inuu noqdaa ugu yaraan 3m, bedka qaybtu waa inuu noqdaa ugu badnaan 6m², agab yar-na waa ka wanaagsan yahay.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s1.prompt: Kee a ayaa buuxiya shuruudaha iyadoo isticmaalaysa agabka ugu yar?
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s1.r.a: Dhererka bartamuhu waa 2m, taas oo ka yar 3m.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s1.r.c: Waxay buuxisaa shuruudaha, laakiin bedku waa qiyaastii 5.3m², sidaas darteed waxay isticmaashaa agab badan.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s1.explain: Dhererka bartamuhu waa a marka x=1, bedkuna waa ∫₀² a·x(2−x)dx=4a/3. Agabka ugu yar ee buuxiya a≥3 iyo 4a/3≤6 waa marka a=3.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s2.model.0: Dhererku waa a≥3, bedka 4a/3≤6-na waxaan ka helnaa a≤4.5, sidaas darteed si agab yar loo isticmaalo a=3 ugu yar ayaa ku habboon.
l-m-h3-b0d08-35.s.s2.model.1: a=2 dhererkiisu waa yar yahay a=6-na wuxuu dhaafayaa xadka bedka, sidaas darteed a=3, kaas oo si dhif ah u buuxiya dhererka, wuxuu isticmaalaa agabka ugu yar.

l-m-h3-b0d08-39.goal: Waqtiga imaatinka T ee v(t)=6t−t², miisaan dhammaan shuruudaha is khilaafsan, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.

l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay T-ga ugu gaaban ee buuxiya shuruudaha?
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.r.a: Isbeddelka booska waa qiyaastii 26.7, taas oo ka yar 27, v(4)=8-na.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.r.b: Isbeddelka booska 30.4 waa ku filan yahay, laakiin v(4.5)=6.75>5.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.r.d: Wuxuu buuxiyaa dhammaan shuruudaha, laakiin wuxuu qaadanayaa wakhti ka dheer T=5.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s1.explain: Isbeddelka booska waa 3T²−T³/3 xawaaraha imaatinkuna waa 6T−T². T=5 waa 33.3 iyo xawaare 5, sidaas darteed labaduba waa la buuxiyay.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s2.model.0: Marka T=5, isbeddelka booska waa 3·25−125/3≈33.3, taas oo ah ugu yaraan 27, v(5)=5-na waa ugu badnaan 5, sidaas darteed doorashooyinka dhexdooda waa wakhtiga ugu gaaban ee ku habboon.
l-m-h3-b0d08-39.s.s2.model.1: T=4 iyo 4.5 way fashilmaan sababtoo ah masaafadu way yartahay ama xawaaruhu aad buu u badan yahay, T=6-na waa dheer yahay, sidaas darteed T=5, oo buuxiya labada shuruudood oo gaaban, ayaa ku habboon.

l-m-h3-b0d09-08.title: Go'aaminta kala fogaanshaha ceelasha biyaha ee harada ellipse
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.topic: Xarumaha iyo dhidibka weyn ee ellipse
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.goal: Naqshadaynta harada ellipse, miisaan dhammaan shuruudaha is-hor-taagan, dooro heshiiska ugu habboon, oo sharax sababta.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.material: Kani waa harada ellipse ah oo dhidibkeeda weyn la dejiyay 20 m. Dhidibka yar waa inuu ahaadaa ugu yaraan 12 m, masaafada u dhexeysa labada ceelood (xarumaha) waa inay ahaataa ugu yaraan 10 m, jidka lugeynta (wareegga) na waa inuu ahaadaa mid dheer intii suurtogal ah. Haddii dhidibka weyn isku mid yahay, marka ay u dhowaato goobo, wareeggu wuu dheeraadaa.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah masaafada ugu habboon ee u dhexeysa ceelasha (2c)?
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.r.b: Wuxuu jebiyaa shuruudda ah in masaafada u dhexeysa ceelashu ay tahay ugu yaraan 10 m.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.r.c: Haddii c=9, dhidibka yar waa qiyaastii 8.7 m, taasoo ka yar 12 m.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.r.d: Wuxuu buuxiyaa shuruudaha, laakiin wareeggu wuxuu noqdaa mid ka gaaban marka 10 m.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s1.explain: Laga bilaabo 2c≥10 iyo dhidibka yar 2√(100−c²)≥12 waxaan helnaa c≤8, sidaas darteed 5≤c≤8. Wareegga ugu dheer wuxuu yahay c ugu yar, 5, taasoo ah 2c=10.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s2.model.0: Masaafada u dhexeysa ceelashu waa ugu yaraan 10 m, shuruudda dhidibka yar na waa c≤8. Tan dhexdeeda, 2c=10, taasoo u dhow goobo, waxay siinaysaa wareegga ugu dheer, sidaas darteed waa ku habboon.
l-m-h3-b0d09-08.s.s2.model.1: 14 m sidoo kale waxay buuxisaa shuruudaha, laakiin waxay ka sii fogaataa goobo jidkuna wuu gaabnaadaa. Sidaas darteed 10 m, kala fogaanshaha ugu yar ee buuxiya shuruudaha, ayaa ugu fiican.
